sentences.zh: 緬甸，古朱波地。

translations.literal: Burma was the ancient land of Zhupo.
translations.idiomatic: Burma was the territory of ancient Pyu.

sentences.zh: 宋寧宗時，緬甸、波斯等國進白象，緬甸通中國自此始。

translations.literal: During the time of Emperor Ningzong of Song, Burma, Persia, and other states presented white elephants; Burma's communication with China began from this.
translations.idiomatic: In the reign of Emperor Ningzong of Song, Burma, Persia, and other states presented white elephants, and Burma's contact with China began from that time.

sentences.zh: 地在雲南西南，最窮遠。

translations.literal: Its territory was in the southwest of Yunnan, the most remote.
translations.idiomatic: Its lands lay southwest of Yunnan, at the farthest remove.

sentences.zh: 有城郭廬舍，多樓居。

translations.literal: It had walled cities and dwellings, and mostly lived in multi-story buildings.
translations.idiomatic: There were walled towns and houses, and people mostly dwelt in raised buildings.

sentences.zh: 元至元中，屢討之，乃入貢。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan era of Yuan, [the court] repeatedly campaigned against them, and they then entered tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhiyuan period of the Yuan, the court campaigned against them repeatedly until they submitted tribute.

sentences.zh: 明太祖即位，遣使賫詔諭之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizu of Ming took the throne, he dispatched envoys bearing edicts to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ming founder took the throne, he sent envoys bearing edicts to announce his rule to them.

sentences.zh: 至安南，留二年，以道阻不能達而返，使者多道卒。

translations.literal: They reached Annam and remained two years; because the route was blocked they could not reach [Burma] and returned, and many of the envoys died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: They reached Annam and stayed two years, but the route was impassable and they could not get through; most of the envoys perished on the journey home.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年，八百國使人入貢，言緬近其地，以遠不能自達。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Hongwu, envoys from the state of Babai came to offer tribute, saying that Burma was near their territory but because of the distance could not reach [the court] on its own.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 26, envoys from Babai presented tribute and reported that Burma lay near them but was too distant to reach the court on its own.

sentences.zh: 帝乃令西平侯沐春遣使至八百國王所，諭意。

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered the Marquis of Xiping, Mu Chun, to dispatch envoys to the king of Babai to convey his intention.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered the Marquis of Xiping, Mu Chun, to send envoys to the king of Babai to convey his wishes.

sentences.zh: 於是緬始遣其臣板南速剌至，進方物，勞賜之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Burma for the first time sent its minister Bannansula, who brought local products; [the court] rewarded him with gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Burma then sent its minister Bannansula for the first time with local products, and the court received him with gifts of reward.

sentences.zh: 二十七年置緬中宣慰使司，以土酋卜剌浪為使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year the Central Burma Pacification Commission was established, with the native chieftain Bolang as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 the Central Burma Pacification Commission was established, with the native chieftain Bolang as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，卜剌浪遣使貢方物，訴百夷思倫發侵奪境土。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Bolang sent envoys offering local products and complained that the Baiyi chieftain Si Lunfa had invaded and seized his territory.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 Bolang sent tribute and complained that the Baiyi leader Si Lunfa had invaded and seized his territory.

sentences.zh: 二十九年復來訴。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he came again to complain.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 he appealed again.

sentences.zh: 帝遣行人李思聰、錢古訓諭緬及百夷各罷兵守土，倫發聽命。

translations.literal: The emperor dispatched the itinerant officials Li Sicong and Qian Guxun to instruct Burma and the Baiyi each to cease hostilities and guard their own lands; Lunfa obeyed the command.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent the itinerant officials Li Sicong and Qian Guxun to instruct Burma and the Baiyi to cease fighting and hold their own lands; Lunfa obeyed.

sentences.zh: 會有百夷部長刀幹孟之亂，逐倫發，以故事得已。

translations.literal: At this time there was the rebellion of the Baiyi sub-chief Dao Ganmeng, who drove out Lunfa, and the matter was thus resolved by circumstance.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the Baiyi sub-chief Dao Ganmeng rebelled and drove out Lunfa, and the affair was settled by events.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，緬酋那羅塔遣使入貢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle, the Burma chieftain Narata sent envoys to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 the Burma chieftain Narata sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 因言緬雖遐裔，願臣屬中國，而道經木邦、孟養，多阻遏。

translations.literal: He stated that although Burma was a distant land, it wished to submit to China as a subject state, but the route passed through Mobang and Mengyang and was often obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: He said that though Burma was a distant realm, it wished to become a subject of China, but the route through Mobang and Mengyang was often blocked.

sentences.zh: 乞命以職，賜冠服、印章，庶免欺陵。

translations.literal: He begged to be appointed to office and granted official robes and seals, so as to avoid bullying.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to be granted office, robes, and a seal so that he might be spared harassment.

sentences.zh: 詔設緬甸宣慰使司，以那羅塔為宣慰使，遣內臣張勤往賜冠帶、印章。

translations.literal: An edict established the Burma Pacification Commission, with Narata as Pacification Commissioner; the inner court eunuch Zhang Qin was sent to bestow a hat, belt, and seal.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established the Burma Pacification Commission with Narata as commissioner, and the palace eunuch Zhang Qin was sent to bestow hat, belt, and seal.

sentences.zh: 於是緬有二宣慰使，皆入貢不絕。

translations.literal: Thus Burma had two Pacification Commissioners, both sending tribute without interruption.
translations.idiomatic: Burma then had two pacification commissioners, and tribute from both never ceased.

sentences.zh: 五年，那羅塔遣使貢方物，謝罪。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Narata sent envoys offering local products to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Narata sent envoys with local products to apologize.

sentences.zh: 先是，孟養宣慰使刀木旦與戛裏相攻，那羅塔乘釁襲之，殺刀木旦及其長子，遂據其地。

translations.literal: Previously, the Mengyang Pacification Commissioner Dao Mudan and Gali had been attacking each other; Narata seized the opportunity to raid them, killed Dao Mudan and his eldest son, and then occupied their territory.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Mengyang commissioner Dao Mudan and Gali had been at war; Narata seized the chance to attack, killed Dao Mudan and his eldest son, and seized their lands.

sentences.zh: 事聞，詔行人張洪等賫敕諭責。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict ordered the itinerant official Zhang Hong and others to deliver imperial instructions of reproof.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, an edict ordered the itinerant official Zhang Hong and others to deliver an imperial reprimand.

sentences.zh: 那羅塔懼，歸其境土，而遣人詣闕謝罪。

translations.literal: Narata was afraid and returned the occupied territory, and sent a person to the capital to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: Narata was afraid, restored the seized territory, and sent a man to the capital to apologize.

sentences.zh: 帝諭禮部曰：「蠻既服辜，其釋不問。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed the Ministry of Rites: "Since the barbarians have repented, release them and do not inquire further.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the Ministry of Rites: "The barbarians have repented; let the matter drop.

sentences.zh: 仍給以信符，令三年一朝貢。

translations.literal: Still grant them credentials of trust, requiring tribute once every three years."
translations.idiomatic: Grant them credentials of trust and require tribute once every three years."

sentences.zh: 初，卜剌浪分其地，使長子那羅塔管大甸，次子馬者速管小甸。

translations.literal: Initially, Bolang divided his territory and had his eldest son Narata administer Greater Dian and his second son Mazesu administer Lesser Dian.
translations.idiomatic: At first Bolang had divided his domain, putting his eldest son Narata in charge of Greater Dian and his second son Mazesu in charge of Lesser Dian.

sentences.zh: 卜剌浪死，那羅塔盡收其弟土地人民。

translations.literal: When Bolang died, Narata took in all his younger brother's land and people.
translations.idiomatic: When Bolang died, Narata seized all his younger brother's lands and people.

sentences.zh: 已而其弟復入小甸，遣人來朝，且訴其情。

translations.literal: Later his younger brother re-entered Lesser Dian, sent a person to court, and explained his situation.
translations.idiomatic: Later his brother re-entered Lesser Dian, sent envoys to court, and stated his case.

sentences.zh: 敕諭那羅塔兄弟和好如初，毋幹天討。

translations.literal: An edict instructed Narata and his brothers to be reconciled as before and not invite heavenly punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told Narata and his brothers to live in peace as before and not invite imperial punishment.

sentences.zh: 六年，那羅塔復遣人入貢，謝罪，並謝賜金牌、信符，勞賜遣之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Narata again sent a person to offer tribute to apologize, and also thanked them for the bestowed gold tablet and credential of trust; [the court] rewarded and sent them away.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 Narata again sent tribute to apologize and to thank the court for the gold tablet and credentials; the envoys were rewarded and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 七年復遣中官雲仙等賫敕賜緬酋金織文綺。

translations.literal: In the seventh year envoys were again sent; the eunuch Yunxian and others carried edicts bestowing gold-woven brocade gauze on the Burma chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 the palace eunuch Yunxian and others were again sent with edicts bestowing gold-woven brocade on the Burma chieftain.

sentences.zh: 十二年，緬人來言為木邦侵掠。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year people from Burma came saying they had been raided by Mobang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 Burmese envoys reported that Mobang had raided them.

sentences.zh: 帝以那羅塔素強橫，遣人諭之，使修好鄰封，各守疆界。

translations.literal: The emperor, knowing Narata had always been overbearing, sent a person to instruct him to maintain good relations with neighboring domains and each guard their own borders.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing Narata had long been overbearing, the emperor sent word instructing him to live at peace with his neighbors and each keep to his own borders.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年遣內官段忠、徐亮以即位詔諭緬甸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongxi, the inner court eunuchs Duan Zhong and Xu Liang were sent with the accession edict to instruct Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongxi 1 the palace eunuchs Duan Zhong and Xu Liang were sent with the accession edict to announce the new reign to Burma.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年遣使往諭雲南土官，賜緬甸錦綺。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande envoys were sent to instruct Yunnan native officials and bestow brocade silks on Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 1 envoys were sent to instruct the Yunnan native officials and bestow brocade silks on Burma.

sentences.zh: 二年以莽得剌為宣慰使。

translations.literal: In the second year Mangdela was made Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 Mangdela was appointed pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 初，緬甸宣慰使新加斯與木邦仇殺而死，子弟潰散。

translations.literal: Previously, the Burma Pacification Commissioner Xinjiasi had been killed in a feud with Mobang, and his sons and younger brothers scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Burma commissioner Xinjiasi had been killed in a feud with Mobang, and his sons and brothers had scattered.

sentences.zh: 緬共推莽得剌權襲，許之。

translations.literal: The people of Burma together promoted Mangdela to act in succession, which was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese jointly put Mangdela forward to succeed provisionally, and this was approved.

sentences.zh: 自是來貢者只署緬甸，而甸中之稱不復見。

translations.literal: From then on those who came to offer tribute signed only "Burma," and the designation "Central [Burma]" was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: From then on tribute missions signed only "Burma," and the name "Central [Burma]" was no longer used.

sentences.zh: 八年，莽得剌遣人來貢，復遣雲仙賫敕賜之，並諭其勿侵木邦地。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Mangdela sent a person to offer tribute; Yunxian was again sent bearing an edict to bestow gifts on him and also instructed him not to invade Mobang territory.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Mangdela sent tribute; Yunxian was again sent with an edict of gifts and instructions not to invade Mobang territory.

sentences.zh: 正統六年給緬甸信符、金牌。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengtong, credentials of trust and a gold tablet were granted to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 6 Burma was granted credentials of trust and a gold tablet.

sentences.zh: 時麓川思任發叛，將討之，命緬甸調兵待。

translations.literal: At that time Luchuan's Si Renfa rebelled; when they were about to campaign against him, Burma was ordered to mobilize troops and wait.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Si Renfa of Luchuan rebelled; as the court prepared to campaign against him, Burma was ordered to mobilize troops and stand ready.

sentences.zh: 七年，任發兵敗，過金沙江，走孟廣，緬人攻之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Renfa's army was defeated, crossed the Jinsha River, fled to Mengguang, and the Burmese attacked him.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Renfa's army was defeated, crossed the Jinsha River, and fled to Mengguang, where the Burmese attacked him.

sentences.zh: 帝諭能擒獻賊首者，予以麓川地。

translations.literal: The emperor announced that whoever could capture and present the rebel leader's head would be granted Luchuan territory.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor proclaimed that whoever could capture and present the rebel leader's head would receive the lands of Luchuan.

sentences.zh: 八年，總督尚書王驥奏，緬甸酋馬哈省、以速剌等已擒獲思任發，不解至，唯以麓川地為言，朝命遂有並征緬甸之命。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Grand Coordinator Minister Wang Ji memorialized that the Burma chieftains Mahasheng and Yisula and others had already captured Si Renfa but would not deliver him—only speaking of Luchuan territory; the court order then included simultaneous campaigning against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Grand Coordinator Wang Ji reported that the Burma chieftains Mahasheng and Yisula had captured Si Renfa but would not hand him over, speaking only of Luchuan territory; the court then ordered a campaign against Burma as well.

sentences.zh: 是時，大師已集騰沖，緬使致書，期以今冬送思任發至貢章交付。

translations.literal: At this time the main army had assembled at Tengchong; Burmese envoys sent a letter promising to deliver Si Renfa at Gongzhang in the coming winter.
translations.idiomatic: The main army had already assembled at Tengchong when Burmese envoys sent a letter promising to deliver Si Renfa at Gongzhang that winter.

sentences.zh: 驥與克期，遣指揮李儀等率精騎通南牙山路，抵貢章，受獻，而緬人送思任發者竟不至。

translations.literal: Ji set a date with them and dispatched Commander Li Yi and others leading elite cavalry via the Nanya mountain route to reach Gongzhang and receive the prisoner, but the Burmese who were to deliver Si Renfa never arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Ji fixed a date and sent Commander Li Yi and others with elite cavalry through the Nanya mountain route to Gongzhang to receive the prisoner, but the Burmese never brought Si Renfa.

sentences.zh: 九年，驥駐師江上，緬人亦嚴兵為備，遣人往來江中，覘官軍虛實。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Ji stationed his army on the river; the Burmese also maintained strict preparations, sending people back and forth on the river to observe the government army's strength.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Ji encamped his army on the river; the Burmese also made strict preparations and sent men back and forth on the river to spy on the government forces.

sentences.zh: 驥以麓川未平，緬難不可復作，乃令總兵官蔣貴等潛焚其舟數百，緬人潰，驥亦班師。

translations.literal: Ji, because Luchuan was not yet pacified and Burma's difficulty should not be revived, ordered General Jiang Gui and others secretly to burn several hundred of their boats; the Burmese scattered in defeat, and Ji also withdrew his army.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, seeing that Luchuan was not yet pacified and Burma must not be provoked again, had General Jiang Gui and others secretly burn several hundred Burmese boats; the Burmese broke and fled, and Ji withdrew his army.

sentences.zh: 於是總兵官沐昂奏：「緬恃險黨賊，應加兵，但滇中方連年征討，財力困弊，旱澇相仍，糧餉不給，未可輕舉。

translations.literal: Then Commander Mu Ang memorialized: "Burma relies on rugged terrain and harbors rebels; troops should be added, but in Yunnan campaigns have followed one upon another for years, financial resources are exhausted, drought and flood succeed each other, provisions cannot be supplied, and we cannot lightly act.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Mu Ang then memorialized: "Burma relies on rugged terrain and shelters rebels; we should send more troops, but Yunnan has been at war year after year, resources are exhausted, drought and flood follow one another, and provisions cannot be supplied—we must not act rashly.

sentences.zh: 臣已遣人諭緬禍福，俾獻賊首。

translations.literal: Your subject has already sent a person to instruct Burma on consequences, ordering them to present the rebel leader's head.
translations.idiomatic: I have already sent men to warn Burma of the consequences and order them to present the rebel leader's head.

sentences.zh: 緬宜聽從。」

translations.literal: Burma should comply."
translations.idiomatic: Burma should comply.

sentences.zh: 十二年，木邦宣慰罕蓋法，緬甸故宣慰子馬哈省、以速剌，遣使偕千戶王政等獻思任發首及諸俘馘至京，並貢方物。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Mobang Pacification Commissioner Hangaifa, former Burma Pacification Commissioners Mahasheng and Yisula, sent envoys together with company commander Wang Zheng and others presenting Si Renfa's head and various captives and trophies to the capital, along with local products.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 Mobang commissioner Hangaifa and the former Burma commissioners Mahasheng and Yisula sent envoys with company commander Wang Zheng and others, presenting Si Renfa's head, captives, and trophies to the capital together with local products.

sentences.zh: 帝命馬哈省、以速剌並為宣慰使，賜敕獎勞，給冠帶、印信。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Mahasheng and Yisula both to be Pacification Commissioners, granted edicts of commendation, and bestowed official robes, seals.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor appointed Mahasheng and Yisula both as pacification commissioners, issued edicts of commendation, and granted robes, seals, and credentials.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以速剌奏求孟養、戛裏地，且請大軍亟滅思任發之子思機發兄弟，而己出兵為助。

translations.literal: Before long Yisula memorialized requesting Mengyang and Gali territory, and also asked that the great army quickly exterminate Si Renfa's sons Si Jifa and his brothers, while he himself would send troops to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yisula memorialized asking for Mengyang and Gali territory and requesting that the main army quickly destroy Si Renfa's sons Si Jifa and his brothers, while he himself would send troops to help.

sentences.zh: 帝諭以機發可不戰擒，宜即滅賊以求分地，弗為他人得也。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed that Jifa could be captured without fighting and that he should quickly destroy the rebels to seek a share of territory, lest others obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that Jifa could be taken without a battle and that he should destroy the rebels at once to win a share of territory before others did.

sentences.zh: 景泰二年賜緬甸陰文金牌、信符。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingtai, yin-script gold tablets and credentials of trust were granted to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai year 2 Burma was granted yin-script gold tablets and credentials of trust.

sentences.zh: 時以速剌久獲思機發不獻，又放思卜發歸孟養。

translations.literal: At that time Yisula had long held Si Jifa without presenting him, and had also released Si Bufa back to Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yisula had long held Si Jifa without presenting him and had also released Si Bufa back to Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 朝廷知其要挾，故緩之。

translations.literal: The court knew he was making demands, so they delayed.
translations.idiomatic: The court knew he was bargaining and therefore proceeded slowly.

sentences.zh: 五年，緬人來索地，參將胡誌以銀戛等地與之，乃送機發及其妻孥。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Burmese came to demand territory; Deputy Commander Hu Zhi gave them places such as Yinga, and they then delivered Jifa together with his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 the Burmese came demanding territory; Deputy Commander Hu Zhi gave them places such as Yinga, and they then delivered Jifa with his wife and children.

sentences.zh: 帝以思卜發既遠遁，不必窮追，仍加賞錦幣，降敕褒獎。

translations.literal: The emperor, since Si Bufa had already fled far away, said there was no need to pursue him to the end; he still added rewards of brocades and coins and issued an edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that since Si Bufa had already fled far away there was no need to pursue him to the end; he still added rewards of brocades and coins and issued an edict of praise.

sentences.zh: 成化七年，鎮守太監錢能言，緬甸宣慰稱貢章、孟養舊為所轄，欲復得之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chenghua, Pacification Commissioner Qian Neng of the garrison eunuch reported that the Burma Pacification Commissioner claimed Gongzhang and Mengyang had formerly been under his jurisdiction and wished to recover them.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 7 the garrison eunuch Qian Neng reported that the Burma commissioner claimed Gongzhang and Mengyang had formerly been under his jurisdiction and wished to recover them.

sentences.zh: 帝命往勘，貢章系木邦、隴川分治，孟養系思洪發所掌，非緬境，乃令雲南守臣傳飭諸部。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered an investigation; Gongzhang was administered jointly by Mobang and Longchuan, and Mengyang was governed by Si Hongfa—neither was Burma's territory; [the court] thus ordered Yunnan officials to transmit instructions to the various domains.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered an investigation; Gongzhang was administered jointly by Mobang and Longchuan, and Mengyang was held by Si Hongfa—neither was Burmese territory—and Yunnan officials were ordered to instruct the various domains.

sentences.zh: 而緬甸以所求地乃前朝所許，貢章乃朝貢必由之途，乞與之。

translations.literal: But Burma said the land they sought had been promised by the previous dynasty, and Gongzhang was the route that tribute missions must take; they begged that it be given to them.
translations.idiomatic: Burma replied that the lands they sought had been promised by the previous dynasty and that Gongzhang was the route tribute missions must take; they begged that these be granted.

sentences.zh: 又乞以金齒軍余李讓為冠帶把事，以備任使。

translations.literal: They also begged to appoint Yu Li of the Jinsi army as a turbaned company commander to be available for service.
translations.idiomatic: They also asked to appoint Yu Li of the Jinsi army as a turbaned company commander for service on demand.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書余子俊等以思洪發不聞有過，豈可奪其地，李讓中國人，而與為把事，亦非體，宜勿許。

translations.literal: Minister of War Yu Zijun and others said Si Hongfa was not known to have committed any offense—how could his land be taken? Yu Li was a Chinese person, and to make him a company commander for them would also not accord with propriety; it should not be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Yu Zijun and others argued that Si Hongfa was not known to have done wrong and his lands could not be seized, and that Yu Li was a Chinese subject—making him a company commander for Burma would be improper; the requests should be denied.

sentences.zh: 帝命兵部諭其使，孟養、貢章是爾朝貢所由，當飭邊臣往諭思洪發，以通道往來，不得阻遏，余勿多望。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Ministry of War to instruct their envoy: "Mengyang and Gongzhang are the routes your tribute takes; border officials should be ordered to go instruct Si Hongfa to keep the passage open for coming and going and not obstruct it; do not hope for more beyond that."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Ministry of War to tell their envoy that Mengyang and Gongzhang were the routes their tribute must take, that border officials should instruct Si Hongfa to keep the passage open, and that they should not expect more.

sentences.zh: 莽紀歲有子瑞體，少奔匿洞吾母家，其酋養為己子。

translations.literal: Mangji had a son Ruiti, who in youth fled and hid with his mother's family in Dongwu; its chieftain raised him as his own son.
translations.idiomatic: Mangji had a son named Ruiti who in youth fled to his mother's kin in Dongwu, where the chieftain raised him as his own son.

sentences.zh: 既長，有其地。

translations.literal: When he grew up, he possessed that territory.
translations.idiomatic: When he came of age he held that territory.

sentences.zh: 洞吾之南有古喇，濱海，與佛郎機鄰。

translations.literal: South of Dongwu was Gula, on the seacoast, neighboring the Franks.
translations.idiomatic: South of Dongwu lay Gula on the coast, bordering the Franks.

sentences.zh: 古喇酋兄弟爭立，瑞體和解之，因德瑞體，爭割地為獻，受其約束，號瑞體為噠喇。

translations.literal: The chieftains of Gula, brothers, contended for the throne; Ruiti mediated and reconciled them, and because they were grateful to Ruiti, they each ceded territory to present to him and accepted his authority, calling Ruiti "Tala."
translations.idiomatic: The Gula chieftains, brothers, fought over the succession; Ruiti mediated between them, and in gratitude they each ceded land to him and submitted to his authority, calling him Tala.

sentences.zh: 瑞體乃舉眾絕古喇糧道，殺其兄弟，盡奪其地，諸蠻皆畏服之。

translations.literal: Ruiti then led his forces to cut off Gula's grain route, killed the brothers, and seized all their land; the various barbarians all feared and submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: Ruiti then led his forces to cut Gula's grain route, killed the brothers, and seized all their lands; the various tribes all feared and submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 時滅緬者木邦、孟養，而與緬相抗者孟密也。

translations.literal: At that time those who had destroyed Burma were Mobang and Mengyang, while Mengmi resisted Burma.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Mobang and Mengyang had destroyed Burma, while Mengmi stood against Burma.

sentences.zh: 孟密土舍兄弟爭立，訴於瑞體。

translations.literal: Mengmi native officials, brothers, contended for the succession and appealed to Ruiti.
translations.idiomatic: Brothers among the Mengmi native officials fought over the succession and appealed to Ruiti.

sentences.zh: 瑞體乃納其弟為婿，改名思忠，遣歸孟密，奪其兄印，因假道攻孟養及迤西諸蠻，以復前仇，又使其黨卓吉侵孟養境。

translations.literal: Ruiti then took the younger brother as son-in-law, renamed him Si Zhong, sent him back to Mengmi, seized his elder brother's seal, and on the pretext of passage attacked Mengyang and the various barbarians of Yixi to settle old scores; he also had his follower Zhuoji invade Mengyang territory.
translations.idiomatic: Ruiti took the younger brother as son-in-law, renamed him Si Zhong, sent him back to Mengmi, seized his elder brother's seal, and under the pretext of passage attacked Mengyang and the tribes of western Yunnan to settle old scores; he also had his follower Zhuoji raid Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 後卓吉為思真婿猛乃頭目別混所殺，瑞體怒，自將攻別混父子，擒之。

translations.literal: Later Zhuoji was killed by Mengyang chieftain Si Zhen's son-in-law, the Mengnai headman Biehun; Ruiti was enraged and personally led an attack on Biehun, father and son, and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhuoji was killed by Si Zhen's son-in-law, the Mengnai headman Biehun; Ruiti was enraged and personally led an attack on Biehun and his son and captured them.

sentences.zh: 遂招誘隴川、幹崖、南甸諸土官，欲入寇。

translations.literal: He then enticed the native officials of Longchuan, Ganya, and Nandian, intending to invade.
translations.idiomatic: He then won over the native officials of Longchuan, Ganya, and Nandian, intending to invade.

sentences.zh: 既覘知有備，又慮他蠻襲其後，乃遁歸。

translations.literal: Having reconnoitered that [they] were prepared, and fearing other barbarians might strike from behind, he fled back.
translations.idiomatic: Finding that they were prepared and fearing other tribes might strike from behind, he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 於是鎮巡官沐朝弼等上其事。

translations.literal: Thereupon the garrison-and-patrol officials Mu Chaobi and others memorialized the court on the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison-and-patrol officials Mu Chaobi and others then reported the matter to the court.

sentences.zh: 兵部覆，荒服之外，治以不治。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War replied that beyond the wild frontier, one governs by not governing.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War replied that beyond the barbarian frontier, the policy should be to govern by leaving them alone.

sentences.zh: 噠喇已畏威遠遁，傳諭諸蠻，不許交通結納。

translations.literal: Tala, having feared the authority, had fled far away; [they] transmitted instructions to the various barbarians, not permitting contact and alliance.
translations.idiomatic: Tala had already fled far off in fear of Ming might; orders were sent to the various tribes forbidding contact and alliances with him.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 時嘉靖三十九年也。

translations.literal: It was the thirty-ninth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: This was in the thirty-ninth year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 木邦土舍罕拔求襲不得，怒投於緬，潞江宣撫錢貴聞之，亦入緬。

translations.literal: Mobang native official Hanba, seeking succession and not obtaining it, in anger defected to Burma; Lujiang Pacification Commissioner Qian Gui, hearing this, also entered Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Hanba, a Mobang native official, sought succession in vain; enraged, he went over to Burma. Lujiang Pacification Commissioner Qian Gui heard of it and joined Burma as well.

sentences.zh: 瑞體自以起孤微，有兵眾，威加諸部，中國復禁絕之，遂謀內侵，乃命錢貴趣召隴川土官多士寧。

translations.literal: Ruiti, considering himself to have risen from humble origins, having troops and imposing might over the various departments, and that China again blocked him, then plotted invasion within the borders; he ordered Qian Gui to urgently summon Longchuan native official Duo Shining.
translations.idiomatic: Ruiti, who saw himself as a man risen from nothing, commanded troops and dominated the surrounding tribes; now that China had cut him off again, he plotted an invasion and ordered Qian Gui to summon Longchuan native official Duo Shining at once.

sentences.zh: 士寧言中國廣大，誡勿妄動，瑞體稍稍寢。

translations.literal: Shining said China's realm was vast and admonished against rash action; Ruiti gradually ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Duo Shining warned that China was vast and urged him not to act rashly; Ruiti gradually abandoned the plan.

sentences.zh: 未幾，士寧為其下嶽鳳所殺，幹崖宣撫刀怕舉亦死。

translations.literal: Before long, Shining was killed by his subordinate Yue Feng; Ganya Pacification Commissioner Dao Pazju also died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Duo Shining was killed by his subordinate Yue Feng, and Ganya Pacification Commissioner Dao Pazju also died.

sentences.zh: 罕拔乃請瑞體入幹崖，幹崖舉，則隴川可坐定也。

translations.literal: Hanba then requested Ruiti enter Ganya; once Ganya was taken, Longchuan could be settled without effort.
translations.idiomatic: Hanba urged Ruiti to enter Ganya: once Ganya was secured, Longchuan could be taken with ease.

sentences.zh: 瑞體子應裏桀黠多智，言於瑞體曰：「隴川、幹崖雖無主，遠難猝取。

translations.literal: Ruiti's son Yingli was crafty and clever; he said to Ruiti: "Although Longchuan and Ganya have no rulers, they are far and hard to seize quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Ruiti's son Yingli was cunning and astute. He said to Ruiti, "Longchuan and Ganya may lack leaders, but they are distant and cannot be taken at a stroke.

sentences.zh: 孟養思個近在肘腋，又吾世仇，萬一乘虛順流下，禍不測。」

translations.literal: Mengyang's Si Ge is close at the elbow and armpit, moreover our hereditary foe; if by chance he seized the void and came downriver, disaster would be unforeseeable.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyang's Si Ge is at our very side, and he is our hereditary enemy; if he should seize the chance to sweep downriver, the harm would be incalculable.

sentences.zh: 瑞體深然之，因借木邦兵一萬取幹崖，而自率兵侵孟養。

translations.literal: Ruiti deeply agreed with this, and so borrowed ten thousand Mobang troops to take Ganya, while he personally led troops to invade Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Ruiti strongly agreed. He borrowed ten thousand Mobang troops to take Ganya and personally led an army against Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 既至，屢為思個所敗，思個亦退保孟倫，相持久之。

translations.literal: Having arrived, he was repeatedly defeated by Si Ge; Si Ge also withdrew to hold Menglun, and both sides stalemate prolonged.
translations.idiomatic: Once he arrived he was repeatedly defeated by Si Ge, who withdrew to hold Menglun; the two sides settled into a prolonged stalemate.

sentences.zh: 而隴川書記嶽鳳欺其主幼，私賫臿賂投緬，結為父子。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Longchuan secretary Yue Feng, deceiving [them] that his lord was young, privately sent bribes and defected to Burma, becoming father and son [allies] with [Ruiti].
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Longchuan secretary Yue Feng, taking advantage of his young lord, secretly sent bribes and went over to Burma, entering a sworn father-son alliance with Ruiti.

sentences.zh: 蠻莫土目思哲亦迎附瑞體，調緬兵萬余，出入於迤西界上，以牽制思個。

translations.literal: Manmo headman Si Zhe also welcomed and attached himself to Ruiti, mobilizing more than ten thousand Burmese troops to move in and out on the Yixi frontier, to pin down Si Ge.
translations.idiomatic: Manmo headman Si Zhe also submitted to Ruiti, mobilizing more than ten thousand Burmese troops to roam the western Yunnan border and pin down Si Ge.

sentences.zh: 復征木邦罕拔兵，會嶽鳳於隴川，襲孟密。

translations.literal: Again he levied Hanba's Mobang troops, joined Yue Feng at Longchuan, and raided Mengmi.
translations.idiomatic: He again raised Hanba's Mobang forces, rendezvoused with Yue Feng at Longchuan, and attacked Mengmi.

sentences.zh: 萬歷元年，緬兵至隴川，入之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wanli, Burmese troops reached Longchuan and entered it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Wanli reign, Burmese troops reached Longchuan and occupied it.

sentences.zh: 嶽鳳遂盡殺士寧妻子族屬，受緬偽命，據隴川為宣撫。

translations.literal: Yue Feng then killed all of Shining's wives, children, and clansmen, received a spurious appointment from Burma, and held Longchuan as Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Feng then slaughtered Duo Shining's wives, children, and entire clan, accepted a spurious Burmese appointment, and seized Longchuan as Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乃與罕拔、思哲盟，必下孟密，奉瑞體以拒中國。

translations.literal: He then allied with Hanba and Si Zhe, vowing to subdue Mengmi and support Ruiti to resist China.
translations.idiomatic: He allied with Hanba and Si Zhe, pledging to conquer Mengmi and uphold Ruiti against China.

sentences.zh: 偽為錦囊象函貝葉緬文，稱西南金樓白象主莽噠喇弄王書報天皇帝，書中嫚辭無狀。

translations.literal: Falsely making a brocade pouch, elephant casket, and palm-leaf Burmese script, [they] styled it a letter from the Southwest Golden Pagoda White Elephant Lord King Mang Tala Nong reporting to the Celestial Emperor; the letter's abusive language was unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: They forged a brocade pouch, elephant casket, and palm-leaf letter in Burmese, addressed to the Son of Heaven as from the Southwest Golden Pagoda White Elephant Lord King Mang Tala Nong; the letter's insults were outrageous.

sentences.zh: 罕拔又為緬招幹崖土舍刀怕文，許代其兄職。

translations.literal: Hanba also recruited for Burma Ganya native official Dao Pawen, promising him his elder brother's office.
translations.idiomatic: Hanba also recruited Ganya native official Dao Pawen for Burma, promising to install him in his elder brother's place.

sentences.zh: 怕文拒之，與戰。

translations.literal: Pawen refused and fought.
translations.idiomatic: Pawen refused and fought back.

sentences.zh: 適應裏率眾二十萬分戍隴、幹間，以其兵驟臨之，怕文潰奔永昌。

translations.literal: Just then Yingli led two hundred thousand men garrisoned between Longchuan and Ganya; with these troops he suddenly pressed upon him, and Pawen was routed and fled to Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Yingli had two hundred thousand men stationed between Longchuan and Ganya; he suddenly descended on Pawen with these forces, and Pawen broke and fled to Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 遂取幹崖印，付罕拔妹，以女官攝宣撫，召盞達副使刀思管、雷弄經歷廖元相佐之，同守幹崖，以防中國。

translations.literal: He then seized Ganya's seal, gave it to Hanba's younger sister, had a female official act as Pacification Commissioner, summoned Zhanda vice commissioner Dao Siguan and Leilong administrator Liao Yuanxiang to assist, and together guarded Ganya against China.
translations.idiomatic: He then took the Ganya seal, gave it to Hanba's sister to hold the Pacification Commission as a female officer, and summoned Zhanda vice commissioner Dao Siguan and Leilong administrator Liao Yuanxiang to help garrison Ganya against China.

sentences.zh: 於是木邦、蠻莫、隴川、幹崖諸蠻，悉附緬，獨孟養未下。

translations.literal: Thereupon Mobang, Manmo, Longchuan, Ganya, and the various barbarians all attached themselves to Burma; only Mengyang was not yet subdued.
translations.idiomatic: Mobang, Manmo, Longchuan, Ganya, and the other tribes all submitted to Burma; only Mengyang remained unconquered.

sentences.zh: 金騰副使許天琦遣指揮侯度持檄撫諭孟養。

translations.literal: Jinteng vice commissioner Xu Tianqi sent commander Hou Du with a proclamation to soothe and instruct Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Jinteng vice commissioner Xu Tianqi sent commander Hou Du with an edict to reassure Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 思個受檄，益拒緬。

translations.literal: Si Ge received the proclamation and all the more refused Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Si Ge accepted the proclamation and resisted Burma all the more fiercely.

sentences.zh: 緬大發兵攻之，思個告急。

translations.literal: Burma greatly mobilized troops to attack him; Si Ge reported urgent distress.
translations.idiomatic: Burma marshaled a large force against him, and Si Ge sent urgent appeals for help.

sentences.zh: 會天琦卒，署事羅汝芳犒思個使，令先歸待援，遂調兵至騰越。

translations.literal: Just then Tianqi died; acting official Luo Rufang rewarded Si Ge's envoys, ordering them to return first and await relief, then mobilized troops to Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Tianqi died just then; the acting official Luo Rufang entertained Si Ge's envoys, told them to return and await relief, and mobilized troops to Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 個聞援兵至，喜，令土目馬祿喇送等領兵萬余，絕緬糧道，且導大兵伏戛撒誘緬兵深入。

translations.literal: Si Ge, hearing relief troops had arrived, was delighted; he ordered headmen Malulasong and others to lead more than ten thousand men to cut Burma's supply lines and also guide the main army to lie in ambush at Gasa to lure Burmese troops deep in.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that relief was coming, Si Ge was delighted. He sent headmen Malulasong and others with more than ten thousand men to cut Burma's supply lines and guide Ming forces into ambush at Gasa to lure the Burmese deep inside.

sentences.zh: 個率蠻卒沖其前，而約援兵自隴川尾擊之。

translations.literal: Si Ge led barbarian soldiers to charge their front, while arranging that relief troops would strike them from the rear at Longchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Si Ge led tribal warriors in a frontal assault while coordinating for relief troops to hit them from the rear through Longchuan.

sentences.zh: 緬兵既敗，糧又絕，屠象馬以食，瑞體窘甚。

translations.literal: Burmese troops having been defeated and provisions also cut off, they slaughtered elephants and horses for food; Ruiti was greatly distressed.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese army was defeated and supplies ran out; they slaughtered elephants and horses for food, and Ruiti was in dire straits.

sentences.zh: 會有陳於巡撫王凝，言生事不便者，凝馳使止援軍。

translations.literal: Just then someone memorialized Grand Coordinator Wang Ning, saying stirring up trouble was inexpedient; Ning urgently sent a messenger stopping the relief army.
translations.idiomatic: Someone then memorialized Grand Coordinator Wang Ning arguing that further hostilities were inexpedient; Wang Ning urgently dispatched orders halting the relief army.

sentences.zh: 汝芳聞檄退，思個待援不至。

translations.literal: Rufang, hearing the order, withdrew; Si Ge awaited relief that did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Rufang withdrew on receipt of the order, and Si Ge waited in vain for relief.

sentences.zh: 嶽鳳偵知之，集隴川兵二千兼程進，導瑞體由間道遁去。

translations.literal: Yue Feng, having reconnoitered and learned this, gathered two thousand Longchuan troops and marched day and night, guiding Ruiti to escape by a hidden route.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Feng learned of this, mustered two thousand Longchuan troops, marched by forced marches, and guided Ruiti out through a secret route.

sentences.zh: 思個追擊之，緬兵大敗，當是時幾獲瑞體。

translations.literal: Si Ge pursued and struck them; Burmese troops were greatly defeated; at that time they nearly captured Ruiti.
translations.idiomatic: Si Ge gave chase and routed the Burmese army; Ruiti was nearly captured.

sentences.zh: 六年，廷議遣使至孟養，俾思個還所俘緬兵象，並賚以金帛，好言慰諭之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, court deliberation sent envoys to Mengyang, ordering Si Ge to return captured Burmese soldiers and elephants, and additionally bestowing gold and silks with kind words to soothe and instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the court decided to send envoys to Mengyang, instructing Si Ge to return the Burmese soldiers and elephants he had captured and presenting gold and silks along with reassuring words.

sentences.zh: 瑞體不謝。

translations.literal: Ruiti did not thank [them].
translations.idiomatic: Ruiti made no acknowledgment.

sentences.zh: 七年，永昌千戶辛鳳奉使買象於孟密，思忠執鳳送緬，緬遣回。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Yongchang company commander Xin Feng, on mission buying elephants at Mengmi, was seized by Si Zhong and sent to Burma; Burma sent him back.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Yongchang company commander Xin Feng was sent to buy elephants in Mengmi; Si Zhong seized him and handed him to Burma, which then sent him back.

sentences.zh: 是年，緬復攻孟養，報戛撒之怨。

translations.literal: That year Burma again attacked Mengyang to settle the grudge of Gasa.
translations.idiomatic: That year Burma attacked Mengyang again to avenge the defeat at Gasa.

sentences.zh: 思個以無援敗，將走騰越，中途為其下所執，送瑞體，殺之，盡並孟養地。

translations.literal: Si Ge, lacking relief, was defeated; about to flee to Tengyue, midway he was seized by his subordinates, sent to Ruiti, and killed; [Ruiti] fully annexed Mengyang territory.
translations.idiomatic: Without relief Si Ge was defeated. As he tried to flee toward Tengyue his own men seized him, handed him over to Ruiti, and he was killed; Ruiti then annexed all of Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 八年，巡撫饒仁侃遣人招緬，緬不應。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Grand Coordinator Rao Renkan sent men to summon Burma; Burma did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Grand Coordinator Rao Renkan sent envoys to summon Burma, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 十年，嶽鳳導緬兵襲破幹崖，奪罕氏印，俘之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Yue Feng guided Burmese troops in a surprise attack that broke Ganya, seized the Han clan seal, and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Yue Feng led Burmese troops in a surprise raid on Ganya, seized the Han seal, and took prisoners.

sentences.zh: 俄，瑞體死，子應裏嗣。

translations.literal: Before long Ruiti died; his son Yingli succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ruiti died and was succeeded by his son Yingli.

sentences.zh: 嶽鳳嗾應裏殺罕拔，盡俘其眾。

translations.literal: Yue Feng incited Yingli to kill Hanba and fully captured his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Feng goaded Yingli into killing Hanba and took all his followers captive.

sentences.zh: 又說應裏起兵象數十萬，分道內侵。

translations.literal: He also persuaded Yingli to raise an army of several hundred thousand with elephants and invade inward by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: He also persuaded Yingli to raise an army of several hundred thousand with war elephants and launch a multi-pronged invasion.

sentences.zh: 十一年焚掠施甸，寇順寧。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year [they] burned and plundered Shidian and raided Shunning.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year they burned and pillaged Shidian and attacked Shunning.

sentences.zh: 鳳子曩烏領眾六萬，突至孟淋寨，指揮吳繼勛、千戶祁維垣戰死。

translations.literal: Feng's son Nang Wu led sixty thousand men, suddenly reaching Menglin Stockade; commander Wu Jixun and company commander Qi Weiyuan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Feng's son Nang Wu led sixty thousand men in a sudden assault on Menglin Stockade; commander Wu Jixun and company commander Qi Weiyuan were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 又破盞達，副使刀思定求救不得，城破，妻子族屬皆盡。

translations.literal: Again [they] broke Zhanda; vice commissioner Dao Siding sought relief without obtaining it; the city fell, and wives, children, and clansmen all perished.
translations.idiomatic: They also overran Zhanda; vice commissioner Dao Siding could obtain no relief; the city fell and his wives, children, and entire clan were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 且窺騰沖、永昌、大理、蒙化、景東、鎮沅諸郡。

translations.literal: Moreover [they] spied on the prefectures Tengchong, Yongchang, Dali, Menghua, Jingdong, and Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: They also threatened Tengchong, Yongchang, Dali, Menghua, Jingdong, and Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 巡撫劉世曾請以南京坐營中軍劉綎為騰越遊擊，移武靖參將鄧子龍為永昌參將，各提兵五千赴剿，並調諸土軍應援。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Liu Shizeng requested that Nanjing garrison middle army officer Liu Ting be made Tengyue mobile corps commander, and Wujing deputy commander Deng Zilong be transferred as Yongchang deputy commander; each would lead five thousand troops to suppress [them], and various native troops would also be mobilized in support.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Liu Shizeng recommended appointing Nanjing garrison middle army officer Liu Ting as Tengyue mobile corps commander and transferring Wujing deputy commander Deng Zilong to Yongchang as deputy commander; each was to lead five thousand men against the invaders, with native forces mobilized in support.

sentences.zh: 緬亦合兵犯姚關，綎與子龍大破之於攀枝花地，乘勝追擊，自十年十月至十一年四月，斬首萬余。

translations.literal: Burma also combined forces and violated Yao Pass; Ting and Zilong greatly defeated them at Panzhihua district, pursued in victory; from the tenth month of the tenth year to the fourth month of the eleventh year, more than ten thousand heads were cut.
translations.idiomatic: Burma also massed troops and attacked Yao Pass; Liu Ting and Deng Zilong routed them at Panzhihua and pursued in victory, beheading more than ten thousand men between the tenth month of the tenth year and the fourth month of the eleventh year.

sentences.zh: 復率兵出隴川、孟密，直抵阿瓦，緬將猛勺詣綎降。

translations.literal: Again [they] led troops out from Longchuan and Mengmi straight to Ava; Burmese general Meng Shao came to Ting and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: They marched again from Longchuan and Mengmi all the way to Ava; the Burmese general Meng Shao came to Liu Ting and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 勺，瑞體弟也。

translations.literal: Shao was Ruiti's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Shao was Ruiti's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 緬將之守隴川、孟養、蠻莫者，皆遁去，嶽鳳及其子皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Burmese generals guarding Longchuan, Mengyang, and Manmo all fled; Yue Feng and his son all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese commanders holding Longchuan, Mengyang, and Manmo all fled; Yue Feng and his son were executed.

sentences.zh: 官軍定隴川，遂歸。

translations.literal: Government troops secured Longchuan, then returned.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial army secured Longchuan and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 應裏乃以其子思鬥守阿瓦，復攻孟養、蠻莫，聲言復仇。

translations.literal: Yingli then had his son Si Dou guard Ava, again attacked Mengyang and Manmo, proclaiming revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Yingli left his son Si Dou to hold Ava, attacked Mengyang and Manmo again, and proclaimed he sought revenge.

sentences.zh: 副使李材備兵騰沖，遣兵援之，戰於遮浪，大破其象陣，生擒五千余人。

translations.literal: Vice commissioner Li Cai prepared troops at Tengchong, sent troops in relief; fighting at Zhelang, he greatly broke their elephant formation and took more than five thousand alive.
translations.idiomatic: Vice commissioner Li Cai gathered forces at Tengchong and sent relief; at Zhelang he shattered the elephant formation and captured more than five thousand men alive.

sentences.zh: 先是，蠻莫酋思化投緬。

translations.literal: Previously, Manmo chieftain Si Hua had defected to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Manmo chieftain Si Hua had gone over to Burma.

sentences.zh: 材遣人招之，思化降。

translations.literal: Cai sent men to summon him; Si Hua surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cai sent envoys to win him over, and Si Hua submitted.

sentences.zh: 十九年，應裏復率緬兵圍蠻莫，思化告急。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Yingli again led Burmese troops to besiege Manmo; Si Hua reported urgent distress.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Yingli again led Burmese troops to besiege Manmo, and Si Hua sent urgent appeals for help.

sentences.zh: 會天暑，軍行不前，裨將萬國春夜馳至，多設火炬為疑兵，緬人懼而退，追敗其眾。

translations.literal: Just then the weather was hot and the army's march did not advance; aide general Wan Guochun rode through the night to arrive, set out many torches as a deception force; Burmese feared and withdrew, and [he] pursued and defeated their host.
translations.idiomatic: The heat stalled the army's advance, but aide general Wan Guochun rode through the night, lit many torches as decoys, and the Burmese withdrew in fear; he pursued and routed them.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，巡撫陳用賓設八關於騰沖，留兵戍守，募人至暹羅約夾攻緬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin established eight passes at Tengchong, left troops to garrison them, and recruited men to Siam to arrange a pincer attack on Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin established eight passes at Tengchong, garrisoned them, and sent agents to Siam to arrange a coordinated attack on Burma.

sentences.zh: 緬初以猛卯酋多俺為向導，寇東路。

translations.literal: Burma initially used Mengmao chieftain Duo An as guide and raided the eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: Burma had first used Mengmao chieftain Duo An as a guide to attack the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 至是遣木邦罕欽擒多俺殺之，逐築堡於猛卯，大興屯田。

translations.literal: At this time [Chen] sent Mobang's Han Qin to capture and kill Duo An, then built fortresses at Mengmao and greatly developed military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: Chen then had Mobang's Han Qin capture and kill Duo An, built fortresses at Mengmao, and greatly expanded military farming colonies.

sentences.zh: 是年，緬帥思仁寇蠻莫，敗之，斬其渠丙測。

translations.literal: That year, Burma commander Si Ren raided Manmo, defeated them, and beheaded their leader Bing Ce.
translations.idiomatic: That year Burmese commander Si Ren attacked Manmo, defeated them, and beheaded their leader Bing Ce.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，應裏屬孟璉、孟艮二土司求朝貢，鎮巡以聞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Yingli had the two native offices of Meng Lian and Meng Gen request court tribute; the garrison-and-patrol officials reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Yingli had the Meng Lian and Meng Gen chieftains seek permission to present tribute, and the frontier officials reported it to the court.

sentences.zh: 朝議令原差官黎景桂賫銀幣賜之，至境，不受。

translations.literal: Court deliberation ordered former envoy Li Jinggui to carry silver and silks to bestow on them; reaching the border, [they] did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered former envoy Li Jinggui to carry silver and silks as gifts, but at the border the Burmese refused to receive them.

sentences.zh: 詔以景桂首事貪功納侮，下於理。

translations.literal: An edict held that Jinggui, taking the lead out of greed for merit, had invited insult, and he was sent to the judicial authorities.
translations.idiomatic: An edict blamed Li Jinggui for seeking credit and courting insult; he was handed over for trial.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，阿瓦雍罕、木邦罕拔子罕𧛾俱入貢，緬勢頓衰。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Ava's Yong Han and Mobang Hanba's son Han He all presented tribute; Burma's power suddenly declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Ava's Yong Han and Hanba's son Han He both came to court with tribute, and Burmese power collapsed sharply.

sentences.zh: 暹羅得楞復連歲攻緬，殺緬長子莽機撾，古喇殘破。

translations.literal: Siam's Deleng attacked Burma year after year, killed Burma's eldest son Mang Jizhua, and Gula was ravaged and broken.
translations.idiomatic: Siam's Deleng attacked Burma year after year, killing Burma's eldest son Mang Jizhua and ravaging Gula.

sentences.zh: 自此不敢內犯，然近緬諸部附之如初。

translations.literal: From this they did not dare invade inward, yet the various departments near Burma attached to them as before.
translations.idiomatic: After this they dared not invade China again, yet the tribes near Burma remained as loyal to them as ever.

sentences.zh: 崇禎末，蠻莫思綿為緬守曩木河。

translations.literal: At the end of Chongzhen, Manmo's Si Mian guarded Namu River for Burma.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Chongzhen reign Manmo's Si Mian held Namu River on Burma's behalf.

sentences.zh: 及黔國公沐天波等隨永明王走蠻莫，思綿使告緬。

translations.literal: When Prince of Qian Mu Tianbo and others followed the Prince of Eternal Brightness fleeing to Manmo, Si Mian sent word informing Burma.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince of Qian Mu Tianbo and others fled to Manmo with the Prince of Eternal Brightness, Si Mian sent word to Burma.

sentences.zh: 緬遣人迎之，傳語述萬歷時事，並出神宗璽書，索今篆合之，以為偽。

translations.literal: Burma sent men to welcome them, relayed words recounting Wanli-era affairs, and produced Emperor Shenzong's sealed edict, demanding the present seal be matched to it, deeming it spurious.
translations.idiomatic: Burma sent envoys to welcome them, recounted affairs from the Wanli reign, and produced Emperor Shenzong's sealed edict, demanding that the present seal be compared with it—they declared it a forgery.

sentences.zh: 天波出己印與先所頒文檄相比無差，始信。

translations.literal: Tianbo produced his own seal and compared it with previously issued proclamations without discrepancy; [they] then believed.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tianbo produced his own seal and compared it with earlier issued documents; finding no discrepancy, they believed him.

sentences.zh: 蓋自天啟後，緬絕貢職，無可考驗雲。

translations.literal: For since after Tianqi, Burma ceased tribute duties and there was nothing by which to verify, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: For since the Tianqi reign Burma had ceased tribute missions, and there had been no way to verify authenticity.

sentences.zh: 幹崖

translations.literal: Ganya
translations.idiomatic: Ganya

translations.literal: (Pacification Commissioner)]〉
translations.idiomatic: (Pacification Commissioner)]〉

sentences.zh: 幹崖，舊名幹賴睒，僰人居之。

translations.literal: Ganya, formerly named Ganlaishan, was inhabited by Bo people.
translations.idiomatic: Ganya, formerly called Ganlaishan, was home to the Bo people.

sentences.zh: 東北接南甸，西接隴川，有平川眾岡。

translations.literal: Northeast it adjoined Nandian, west it adjoined Longchuan; there were level plains and many hills.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered Nandian to the northeast and Longchuan to the west, with level plains and many hills.

sentences.zh: 境內甚熱，四時皆蠶，以其絲織五色土錦充貢。

translations.literal: Within the territory it was very hot; silkworms [were raised] in all four seasons, and with their silk five-colored native brocade was woven as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The climate was very hot; sericulture continued year-round, and silk was woven into multicolored native brocade for tribute.

sentences.zh: 元中統初，內附。

translations.literal: In the early Zhongtong period of Yuan, [they] submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Zhongtong period of the Yuan dynasty it submitted to the empire.

sentences.zh: 至元中，置鎮西路軍民總管府，領三甸。

translations.literal: In the middle Zhiyuan period, Zhenxi Road Military-Civilian General Administration Office was established, governing Three Dian.
translations.idiomatic: In the middle Zhiyuan period the Zhenxi Road Military-Civilian General Administration Office was established, governing the Three Dian districts.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年改鎮西府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu it was changed to Zhenxi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 15 it was renamed Zhenxi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年設幹崖長官司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle Ganya Chief Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 the Ganya Chief Native Office was established.

sentences.zh: 二年頒給信符、金字紅牌並賜冠服。

translations.literal: In the second year credentials of trust, gold-lettered red plaques were issued and official caps and robes were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year it received credentials of trust, gold-lettered red plaques, and official robes and insignia.

sentences.zh: 三年，幹崖長官曩歡遣頭目奉表貢馬及犀、象、金銀器，謝恩，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the third year, Ganya chief Nang Huan sent headmen presenting a memorial, tribute of horses and rhinoceros horn, elephants, and gold and silver vessels, thanking for grace; paper money was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Ganya chief Nang Huan sent subordinates with a memorial, presenting horses, rhinoceros horn, elephants, and gold and silver vessels in gratitude; he was rewarded with paper money.

sentences.zh: 五年設古剌驛，隸幹崖。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Gula Post Station was established, subordinate to Ganya.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Gula courier station was established under Ganya.

sentences.zh: 曩歡復遣子刀思曩朝貢，賜賚如例。

translations.literal: Nang Huan again sent his son Dao Sinang to court with tribute; rewards followed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Nang Huan again sent his son Dao Sinang to court with tribute and received the usual rewards.

sentences.zh: 自是，三年一朝貢不絕。

translations.literal: From this, once every three years court tribute did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: From then on tribute missions came every three years without interruption.

sentences.zh: 宣德六年改隸雲南都司。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xuande it was changed to be subordinate to Yunnan Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 6 it was placed under the Yunnan Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 時長官刀弄孟奏，其地近雲南都司，而歲納差發銀於金齒衛，路遠，乞改隸，而輸銀於布政司。

translations.literal: At the time chief Dao Nongmeng memorialized that their land was near Yunnan Regional Military Commission, yet yearly corvée silver was paid at Jinchi Guard; the road was far; he requested change of subordination and paying silver to the Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Dao Nongmeng then memorialized that his territory lay close to the Yunnan commission yet had to pay corvée silver to distant Jinchi Guard; he asked to be reassigned and to pay instead to the provincial administration.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The request] was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 正統三年命仍隸金齒軍民指揮使司。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengtong it was ordered again subordinate to Jinchi Military-Civilian Command.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 3 it was ordered back under the Jinchi Military-Civilian Command.

sentences.zh: 六年升幹崖副長官刀怕便為長官司，賜彩幣，以歸附後屢立功，從總兵官沐昂請也。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Ganya vice chief Dao Pabian was promoted to chief office; colored silks were bestowed; because after submission he repeatedly achieved merit, following commander Mu Ang's request.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year vice chief Dao Pabian was promoted to chief of the office and rewarded with colored silks, at the request of Commander Mu Ang, for repeated meritorious service after submission.

sentences.zh: 九年升幹崖為宣撫司，以刀怕便為宣撫副使，劉英為同知，從總督王驥請也。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Ganya was promoted to Pacification Commission, with Dao Pabian as Pacification Vice Commissioner and Liu Ying as associate commissioner, following Grand Coordinator Wang Ji's request.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Ganya was raised to a Pacification Commission; Dao Pabian became vice commissioner and Liu Ying associate commissioner, at Grand Coordinator Wang Ji's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年，幹崖土舍刀愈怕欺其侄刀怕落幼，劫印奪職。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongzhi, Ganya native official Dao Yupa, deceiving that his nephew Dao Paluo was young, seized the seal and usurped the office.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 3 Ganya native official Dao Yupa, taking advantage of his young nephew Dao Paluo, seized the seal and usurped the office.

sentences.zh: 蠻眾不服，遂起兵相攻。

translations.literal: The barbarian masses were not submissive, and so raised troops to attack one another.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes refused to accept this and took up arms against one another.

sentences.zh: 四年，按察司副使林俊同參將沐詳移文往諭，始釋兵歸印。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, regional inspector vice commissioner Lin Jun together with deputy commander Mu Xiang sent a written proclamation to instruct them; only then did they release troops and return the seal.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 4, vice commissioner of the regional inspectorate Lin Jun and deputy commander Mu Xiang sent a proclamation of instruction, after which the factions disbanded and restored the seal.

sentences.zh: 事聞，帝以鎮巡官不以時奏報，責之。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor, because the garrison-patrol officials had not memorialized in timely fashion, rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, the emperor rebuked the garrison and patrol officials for failing to report in a timely manner.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十九年，緬酋莽瑞體叛，招幹崖諸土官入寇。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year of Jiajing, Burma chieftain Mang Ruiti rebelled and summoned Ganya's various native officials to invade.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 39, the Burmese chieftain Mang Ruiti rebelled and drew Ganya's native officials into an invasion.

sentences.zh: 萬歷初，宣撫刀怕舉死，妻罕氏，木邦宣慰罕拔妹也。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wanli, Pacification Commissioner Dao Pazju died; his wife Lady Han was the younger sister of Mobang Pacification Commissioner Hanba.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Wanli reign Pacification Commissioner Dao Pazju died, leaving his wife Lady Han, who was the younger sister of Mobang Pacification Commissioner Hanba.

sentences.zh: 拔既叛附緬，召怕舉弟怕文襲職以臣緬，且許以妹。

translations.literal: Hanba having already rebelled and attached to Burma, summoned Pazju's younger brother Pawen to succeed to the office in order to serve Burma, and moreover promised him his sister.
translations.idiomatic: Hanba had already gone over to Burma; he summoned Pazju's younger brother Pawen to succeed to the office as a vassal of Burma and promised him his sister in marriage.

sentences.zh: 怕文不受，與戰。

translations.literal: Pawen did not accept and fought.
translations.idiomatic: Pawen refused and fought back.

sentences.zh: 緬兵十萬驟臨，怕文潰奔永昌。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand Burmese troops suddenly arrived; Pawen was routed and fled to Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: A Burmese army of one hundred thousand descended without warning; Pawen was routed and fled to Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 罕拔遂取幹崖印付罕氏。

translations.literal: Hanba thereupon took Ganya's seal and gave it to Lady Han.
translations.idiomatic: Hanba then took the Ganya seal and gave it to Lady Han.

sentences.zh: 十年，隴川嶽鳳破幹崖，奪罕氏印。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Longchuan's Yue Feng broke Ganya and seized Lady Han's seal.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 10 Yue Feng of Longchuan overran Ganya and seized the Han seal.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遊擊劉綎破隴川，鳳降，追印竟不得。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, mobile corps commander Liu Ting broke Longchuan; Feng surrendered, but in pursuit of the seal it was ultimately not obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 11 mobile corps commander Liu Ting defeated Longchuan; Yue Feng surrendered, but the seal could not be recovered despite the chase.

sentences.zh: 而幹崖部眾自相承代，亦莫得而考雲。

translations.literal: As for Ganya's followers, they hereditarily succeeded one another among themselves; this likewise cannot be examined and verified.
translations.idiomatic: Ganya's people thereafter succeeded one another on their own, and the succession can no longer be traced.

sentences.zh: 潞江，地在永昌、騰越之間，南負高侖山，北臨潞江，為官道咽喉。

translations.literal: Lujiang—its territory lies between Yongchang and Tengyue; south it backs on Mount Gaolun, north it faces the Lujiang River, and it is the vital point of the official road.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiang lies between Yongchang and Tengyue, backed by Mount Gaolun to the south and facing the Lujiang River to the north—a choke point on the main road.

sentences.zh: 地多瘴癘，蠻名怒江甸。

translations.literal: The land has much miasma; the barbarians call it Nujiangdian.
translations.idiomatic: The region is heavily afflicted by miasma; the tribes call it Nujiangdian.

sentences.zh: 至元間，隸柔遠路。

translations.literal: During the Zhiyuan period it was subordinate to Rouyuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was placed under Rouyuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年內附，設潞江長官司。

translations.literal: In Yongle 1 [they] submitted to the interior and the Lujiang Chief Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 the region submitted and the Lujiang Chief Office was established.

sentences.zh: 其地舊屬麓川平緬，西平侯奏其地廣人稠，宜設長官司治之。

translations.literal: That territory had formerly belonged to Luchuan Pingmian; the Prince of Xiping memorialized that its land was broad and population dense, and that a chief office should be established to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: The area had formerly belonged to Luchuan Pingmian; the Prince of Xiping recommended establishing a chief office, citing its broad territory and dense population.

sentences.zh: 二年頒給信符、金字紅牌。

translations.literal: In the second year credentials and gold-letter red plaques were issued.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 credentials and gold-letter red plaques were issued.

sentences.zh: 九年，潞江長官司曩璧遣子維羅法貢馬、方物，賜鈔幣，尋升為安撫司。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Lujiang Chief Nang Bi sent his son Weiluofa to present tribute horses and local products; paper money was bestowed, and shortly thereafter [the office] was promoted to a Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Chief Nang Bi of Lujiang sent his son Weiluofa with horses and tribute goods; paper money was granted, and the office was soon raised to a Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 曩璧來朝，貢象、馬、金銀器，謝恩。

translations.literal: Nang Bi came to court, presented tribute elephants, horses, and gold and silver vessels, and expressed gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: Nang Bi came to court with elephants, horses, and gold and silver vessels in tribute, thanking the throne for his rewards.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，曩璧遣人貢馬，請改隸雲南布政司，從之。

translations.literal: In Xuande 1, Nang Bi sent men to present tribute horses and requested change of subordination to the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 1 Nang Bi sent tribute horses and asked to be placed under the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 遣中官雲仙賫敕及綺幣賜曩璧。

translations.literal: A eunuch, Yunxian, was dispatched bearing an edict and brocade silks to bestow on Nang Bi.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent the eunuch Yunxian with an imperial edict and brocade silks as gifts for Nang Bi.

sentences.zh: 三年，黔國公沐晟奏，潞江千夫長刀不浪班叛歸麓川，劫潞江，逐曩璧入金齒，據潞江驛，逐驛丞周禮，立寨固守，斷絕道路，請發兵討。

translations.literal: In the third year, Prince of Qian Mu Sheng memorialized that Lujiang company commander Dao Bulangban had rebelled and returned to Luchuan, raided Lujiang, drove Nang Bi into Jinchi, seized Lujiang Post Station, expelled post commissioner Zhou Li, established stockades and held firm, cut off the roads, and requested dispatch of troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 Prince of Qian Mu Sheng reported that Lujiang company commander Dao Bulangban had defected to Luchuan, raided Lujiang, driven Nang Bi into Jinchi, seized Lujiang Post Station, expelled post commissioner Zhou Li, fortified stockades, and blocked the roads; he requested a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 帝敕晟與三司計議。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Sheng to deliberate with the three commissions.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Mu Sheng to consult with the three provincial commissions.

sentences.zh: 五年，晟奏，刀不浪班懼罪，還所據地，歸舊部，輸役如故，乞宥之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Sheng memorialized that Dao Bulangban, fearing punishment, returned the territory he had seized, rejoined his former unit, rendered labor service as before, and begged forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Mu Sheng reported that Dao Bulangban, fearing punishment, had restored the seized lands, rejoined his former command, resumed his duties, and sought pardon.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Reply: approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 是年置雲南廣邑州。

translations.literal: That year Yunnan Guangyi Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Guangyi Prefecture was established in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 時雲仙還言：「金齒廣邑寨，本永昌副千戶阿幹所居。

translations.literal: At the time Yunxian on returning reported: "Jinchi Guangyi Stockade was originally where Yongchang deputy company commander A Gan resided.
translations.idiomatic: On his return Yunxian reported: "The Guangyi Stockade at Jinchi was originally the seat of Yongchang deputy company commander A Gan.

sentences.zh: 幹嘗奉命招生蒲五千戶向化。

translations.literal: Gan had once received orders to recruit five thousand Pu households to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Gan had once been ordered to win over five thousand Pu households.

sentences.zh: 今幹孫阿都魯同蒲酋莽塞等詣京貢方物，乞於廣邑置州，使阿都魯掌州事，以熟蒲並所招生蒲屬之。」

translations.literal: Now Gan's grandson A Dulun together with Pu chieftains Mang Sai and others came to the capital to present tribute and requested that a prefecture be established at Guangyi, that A Dulun administer prefectural affairs, and that assimilated Pu and the recruited Pu be placed under it."
translations.idiomatic: Now Gan's grandson A Dulun, together with Pu chiefs including Mang Sai, came to court with tribute and asked that a prefecture be established at Guangyi with A Dulun as prefect, placing both the assimilated Pu and the newly recruited Pu under his jurisdiction."

sentences.zh: 帝從之，遂以阿都魯為廣邑州知州，莽塞為同知，鑄印給之。

translations.literal: The emperor assented; thereupon A Dulun was made prefect of Guangyi Prefecture, Mang Sai associate prefect, and seals were cast and issued.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed; A Dulun was appointed prefect of Guangyi Prefecture, Mang Sai associate prefect, and seals were cast and issued.

sentences.zh: 八年改金齒永昌千戶所為潞江州，隸雲南布政司，以千夫長刀珍罕為知州，刀不浪班為同知，置吏目及清水關巡檢各一員。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Jinchi Yongchang company was changed to Lujiang Prefecture, subordinate to the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission; company commander Dao Zhenhan was made prefect, Dao Bulangban associate prefect, and one clerical officer and one Qingshuiguan inspection commissioner were each established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 the Jinchi Yongchang company was converted into Lujiang Prefecture under the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission; company commander Dao Zhenhan became prefect and Dao Bulangban associate prefect, with one clerical officer and one Qingshuiguan inspection commissioner appointed.

sentences.zh: 正統三年從黔國公沐晟奏，改潞江安撫司仍隸金齒，悉還舊制。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong year 3, following Prince of Qian Mu Sheng's memorial, Lujiang Pacification Commission was changed to remain subordinate to Jinchi and all former arrangements were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 3, on Mu Sheng's recommendation, Lujiang Pacification Commission was returned to Jinchi jurisdiction and the former system fully restored.

sentences.zh: 五年，安撫使線舊法以麓川思任發叛來告，諭整兵以俟。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Pacification Commissioner Xian Jiufa reported that Luchuan's Si Renfa had rebelled; he was instructed to ready troops and await orders.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Pacification Commissioner Xian Jiufa reported Si Renfa's Luchuan rebellion and was ordered to ready his troops pending further instructions.

sentences.zh: 未幾，麓川賊遣部眾奪據潞江，殺傷官軍，潞江遂削弱。

translations.literal: Before long, Luchuan bandits sent followers to seize and hold Lujiang, killed and wounded government troops, and Lujiang was thereby weakened.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Luchuan rebels sent forces to seize Lujiang, killing and wounding imperial troops; Lujiang was thereby enfeebled.

sentences.zh: 正德十六年，安撫司土官安捧奪其從弟掩莊田三十八所，掩訟於官，不報。

translations.literal: In Zhengde year 16, Pacification Commission native official An Peng seized thirty-eight estates of his younger cousin Yan; Yan sued at the yamen and received no response.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde year 16 native official An Peng seized thirty-eight estates belonging to his cousin Yan; Yan lodged a complaint with the authorities but received no answer.

sentences.zh: 捧遂集蠻兵圍掩寨，縱火屠掠，掩母子妻妾及蠻民男婦死者八十余人，據有其地。

translations.literal: Peng then gathered barbarian troops, besieged Yan's stockade, set fire and slaughtered and plundered; Yan's mother, son, wives and concubines and barbarian men and women who died numbered more than eighty; he seized and held the territory.
translations.idiomatic: Peng mustered tribal troops, besieged Yan's stockade, and burned and pillaged it; Yan's mother, son, wives, and more than eighty tribesmen were killed, and Peng seized the land.

sentences.zh: 官軍誘執之，捧死於獄。

translations.literal: Government troops lured and captured him; Peng died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops lured him into capture; Peng died in prison.

sentences.zh: 帝命戮屍棄市，其子詔及黨與皆斬。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered his corpse dismembered and exposed in the marketplace; his son Zhao and accomplices were all beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Peng's corpse dismembered and exposed in the marketplace; his son Zhao and his followers were all beheaded.

sentences.zh: 天啟間，有線世祿者，繼襲安撫。

translations.literal: During the Tianqi period there was one Xian Shilu who successively inherited the pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianqi reign Xian Shilu succeeded to the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 南甸

translations.literal: Nandian
translations.idiomatic: Nandian

sentences.zh: 〈（二宣撫司）〉

translations.literal: (two Pacification Commission offices)]〉
translations.idiomatic: (two Pacification Commission offices)]〉

sentences.zh: 南甸宣撫司，舊名南宋，在騰越南半個山下，其山巔北多霜雪，南則炎瘴如蒸。

translations.literal: Nandian Pacification Commission, formerly called Nansong, lies below Half Mountain south of Tengyue; on its summit north there is much frost and snow, south then blazing miasma like steaming heat.
translations.idiomatic: The Nandian Pacification Commission, formerly called Nansong, lies beneath Half Mountain south of Tengyue; its peak is frosty and snowbound to the north, while the southern slopes swelter under oppressive miasma.

sentences.zh: 元置南甸路軍民總管府，領三甸。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan Nandian Circuit Military-Civilian Command was established, governing three dian.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established the Nandian Circuit Military-Civilian Command, governing three districts.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年改南甸府。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 15 it was changed to Nandian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 15 it was renamed Nandian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂十一年改為州，隸布政司。

translations.literal: In Yongle year 11 it was changed to a prefecture subordinate to the Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle year 11 it was made a prefecture under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 宣德三年，南甸為麓川侵奪，有司請討。

translations.literal: In Xuande year 3, Nandian was invaded and seized by Luchuan; the responsible officials requested a punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 3 Luchuan seized Nandian territory, and local officials requested a punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 不許，降敕誡諭麓川，俾還侵地。

translations.literal: Not permitted; an edict was issued admonishing Luchuan and ordering return of seized territory.
translations.idiomatic: Permission was denied; instead an edict admonished Luchuan and ordered the return of seized lands.

sentences.zh: 五年，南甸州奏：「先被麓川宣慰司奪其境土，賴朝廷威力復之，若不置官司以正疆界，恐侵奪未厭，乞置四巡檢司鎮之。」

translations.literal: In the fifth year Nandian Prefecture memorialized: "Formerly our territory was seized by Luchuan Pacification Commission; relying on the court's might it was recovered. If offices are not established to fix boundaries, we fear seizure may not end; we beg to establish four inspection commissions to garrison it."
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Nandian memorialized: "Luchuan Pacification Commission had seized our territory, which we recovered only through imperial power. Without offices to demarcate the border, we fear further encroachment; we request four inspection commissions to guard the frontier."

sentences.zh: 帝命吏部除官。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Personnel to appoint officials.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Personnel to appoint the officials.

sentences.zh: 八年又奏：「與麓川接境，舊十二百夫長在騰沖千戶所時，賴邦哈等處軍民兼守。

translations.literal: In the eighth year [they] again memorialized: "Adjoining Luchuan, when the former twelve company commanders were under the Tengchong company, Laibangha and other places had military and civilians jointly guarding.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 they memorialized again: "Bordering Luchuan, when the twelve company commanders were attached to Tengchong, Laibangha and other posts had been jointly garrisoned by soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 後麓川侵據，不守者十余年。

translations.literal: Later Luchuan invaded and seized [them]; for more than ten years they were not guarded.
translations.idiomatic: After Luchuan seized them, the posts went unguarded for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 今蒙敕諭還，竊恐再侵，百姓逃移，乞於賴邦哈、九浪、莽孟洞三處各置巡檢，以土軍楊義等三人為之。」

translations.literal: Now having received the edict ordering return, we privately fear renewed invasion and the flight of the populace; we beg inspection commissioners be established at Laibangha, Jiulang, and Mangmengdong, with native soldiers Yang Yi and two others appointed."
translations.idiomatic: Now that an edict has ordered their return, we fear renewed invasion and flight of the people; we request inspection commissioners at Laibangha, Jiulang, and Mangmengdong, with native officers Yang Yi and two others appointed."

sentences.zh: 命下三司勘覆，授之。

translations.literal: Orders were sent to the three commissions to investigate and confirm, and appointments were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the three commissions for inspection and confirmation, and the appointments were made.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，土知州刀貢罕奏：「麓川思任發奪其所轄羅卜思莊二百七十八村，乞遣使賫金牌、信符諭之退還。」

translations.literal: In Zhengtong year 2, native prefect Dao Gunghan memorialized: "Luchuan's Si Renfa has seized two hundred seventy-eight villages of Luobusi Estate under my jurisdiction; we beg envoys be sent bearing gold plaques and credentials to instruct him to withdraw and return them."
