translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 2 native prefect Dao Gunghan memorialized that Si Renfa of Luchuan had seized 278 villages of Luobusi Estate under his jurisdiction and requested envoys with gold plaques and credentials to order their return."

sentences.zh: 帝敕沐晟處置奏聞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Mu Sheng to handle the matter and report.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Mu Sheng to take action and report back.

sentences.zh: 麓川之役自是起。

translations.literal: The Luchuan campaign began from this.
translations.idiomatic: The Luchuan campaigns began from this point.

sentences.zh: 九年升州為宣撫司，以知州刀落硬為宣撫使，通判劉思勉為土同知。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the prefecture was promoted to Pacification Commission; prefect Dao Luoying was made pacification commissioner and administrative assistant Liu Simian native associate commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 the prefecture was raised to a Pacification Commission; Prefect Dao Luoying became pacification commissioner and Liu Simian became native associate commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六年頒給金牌、信符、勘合，加敕諭之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year gold plaques, credentials, and tally slips were issued, with an additional edict of instruction.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 6 gold plaques, credentials, and tally slips were issued, along with a special edict of instruction.

sentences.zh: 十年免所欠差發銀兩，令安業後，仍前科辦。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the owed corvée silver was remitted; after settling into their livelihoods, levies would proceed as before.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 arrears of corvée silver were forgiven; once the people had reestablished their livelihoods, the former levies would resume.

sentences.zh: 天順二年復置南甸驛丞一人，以土人為之。

translations.literal: In Tianshun year 2 one Nandian post commissioner was again established, with a native as appointee.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun year 2 a Nandian post commissioner was reinstated, filled by a native appointee.

sentences.zh: 時宣撫刀落蓋奏南寧伯毛勝遣騰沖千戶藺愈占其招八地，逼民逃竄。

translations.literal: At the time Pacification Commissioner Dao Luogai memorialized that Ningnan Earl Mao Sheng had sent Tengchong company commander Lan Yu to seize his Zhaoba territory, forcing the people to flee.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Dao Luogai then reported that Ningnan Earl Mao Sheng had sent Tengchong company commander Lan Yu to seize Zhaoba territory, driving the people to flight.

sentences.zh: 敕雲南三司官同巡按御史詣其地體勘，以所占田寨退還，治勝、愈罪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yunnan three-commission officials together with the touring censor to go to the place and conduct an on-site investigation; seized fields and stockades were to be returned, and Sheng and Yu punished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Yunnan three commissions and the touring censor to inspect the site, return the seized fields and stockades, and punish Mao Sheng and Lan Yu.

sentences.zh: 南甸所轄羅卜思莊與小隴川，皆百夫長之分地。

translations.literal: Luobusi Estate and Lesser Longchuan under Nandian's jurisdiction were both allotment lands of company commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Luobusi Estate and Lesser Longchuan under Nandian were both company-commander allotments.

sentences.zh: 知事謝氏居曩宋，悶氏居盞西，屬部直抵金沙江，地最廣。

translations.literal: Administrative officer the Xie clan resided at Nangsong, the Men clan at Zhanxi; subordinate territories reached straight to the Jinsha River—the land was broadest.
translations.idiomatic: The Xie clan of the administrative office lived at Nangsong, the Men clan at Zhanxi; their domains reached the Jinsha River and formed the broadest territory.

sentences.zh: 司東十五里曰蠻幹，宣撫世居之。

translations.literal: Fifteen li east of the commission it was called Manggan, where the pacification commissioners resided for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen li east of the commission seat lay Manggan, the hereditary residence of the pacification commissioners.

sentences.zh: 南百里有關，立木為柵，周一里。

translations.literal: One hundred li south there was a pass; wooden palisades were erected, enclosing one li in circumference.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred li to the south stood a pass ringed with wooden palisades enclosing one li.

sentences.zh: 曰南牙，甚高，山勢延袤一百餘里，官道經之。

translations.literal: It was called Nanya, very high; the mountain range extended more than one hundred li, and the official road passed through it.
translations.idiomatic: This was Nanya—a towering ridge stretching more than a hundred li, through which the main road ran.

sentences.zh: 上有石梯，蠻人據以為險。

translations.literal: Above were stone steps; the barbarians held them as a strategic strongpoint.
translations.idiomatic: Stone steps led up its heights, which the tribes held as a natural fortress.

sentences.zh: 芒市，舊曰怒謀，又曰大枯夾、小枯夾，在永昌西南四百里，即唐史所謂茫施蠻也。

translations.literal: Mang City, formerly called Numou, also called Greater Kujia and Lesser Kujia, four hundred li southwest of Yongchang—it is the Mangshi barbarians spoken of in Tang histories.
translations.idiomatic: Mang City, formerly Numou and also called Greater and Lesser Kujia, lay four hundred li southwest of Yongchang—the Mangshi tribe recorded in Tang histories.

sentences.zh: 元中統初內附。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhongtong under the Yuan [they] submitted to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Yuan Zhongtong era the region submitted.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年立茫施路軍民總管府，領二甸。

translations.literal: In Yuan year 13 Mangshi Circuit Military-Civilian Command was established, governing two dian.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan year 13 the Mangshi Circuit Military-Civilian Command was established, governing two districts.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年，置茫施府。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 15 Mangshi Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 15 Mangshi Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 正統七年，總兵官沐晟奏：「芒市陶孟刀放革遣人來訴，與叛寇思任發有仇。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong year 7, commander Mu Sheng memorialized: "Mang City's taomeng Dao Fangge sent men to complain that he had a grudge against the rebel bandit Si Renfa.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 7 Commander Mu Sheng reported: "Mang City taomeng Dao Fangge sent envoys stating that he bore a grudge against the rebel Si Renfa.

sentences.zh: 今任發已遁去，思機發兄弟三人來居麓川者藍地方，願擒以獻。」

translations.literal: Now Renfa has already fled away; Si Jifa and his three brothers have come to dwell at Zhelan in Luchuan territory, and [Fangge] wishes to capture them and present them."
translations.idiomatic: Renfa has already fled, but his brother Si Jifa and two others now hold Zhelan in Luchuan; Fangge offered to capture them and deliver them up."

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「放革先與任發同惡，今勢窮乃言結釁，譎詐難信。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "Fangge formerly shared wickedness with Renfa; now cornered he speaks of settling enmity—crafty and deceitful, hard to trust.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War replied: "Fangge had once joined Renfa in rebellion; now, with his cause failing, he speaks of settling old scores—his cunning makes him hard to trust.

sentences.zh: 宜敕諭放革，如能去逆效順，當密調土兵助剿機發。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to instruct Fangge by edict that if he can abandon rebellion and show loyalty, native troops should secretly be mobilized to assist in suppressing Jifa."
translations.idiomatic: Fangge should be instructed by edict that if he renounces rebellion and submits, native troops may secretly be mobilized to help capture Jifa."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [This] was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 八年，機發令其黨涓孟車等來攻芒市，為官軍所敗。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Jifa ordered his followers Juan Mengche and others to come attack Mang City; they were defeated by government troops.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Jifa sent his followers Juan Mengche and others against Mang City, but government troops defeated them.

sentences.zh: 放革來降，靖遠伯王驥請設芒市長官司，以陶孟刀放革為長官，隸金齒衛。

translations.literal: Fangge came to surrender; Jingyuan Earl Wang Ji requested establishment of Mang City Chief Office, with taomeng Dao Fangge as chief, subordinate to Jinchi Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Fangge submitted; Jingyuan Earl Wang Ji recommended establishing the Mang City Chief Office with taomeng Dao Fangge as chief, under Jinchi Guard.

sentences.zh: 成化八年，木邦曩罕弄亂，掠隴川。

translations.literal: In Chenghua year 8, Mobang's Nang Hannong rebelled and plundered Longchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 8 Nang Hannong of Mobang rebelled and raided Longchuan.

sentences.zh: 敕芒市等長官司整兵備調。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Mang City and other chief offices to ready troops and prepare for mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Mang City chief office and others to ready their forces for deployment.

sentences.zh: 萬歷初，長官放福與隴川嶽鳳聯姻，導緬寇松坡營。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wanli, Chief Fang Fu allied by marriage with Longchuan's Yue Feng and guided Burmese raiders to Songpo Camp.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Wanli Chief Fang Fu married into Yue Feng's Longchuan clan and guided Burmese raiders to Songpo Camp.

sentences.zh: 事覺，伏誅，立舍目放緯領司事，轄於隴川。

translations.literal: When the matter was discovered, [Fang Fu] was executed; headman Fang Wei was established to administer office affairs, placed under Longchuan's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: When the plot was exposed Fang Fu was executed; headman Fang Wei was installed to administer the office under Longchuan's supervision.

sentences.zh: 芒市川原廣邈，田土富饒，而人稍脆弱雲。

translations.literal: Mang City's plains and marshes were broad and far-reaching, fields and soil rich and fertile, but the people were somewhat fragile—or so it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Mang City's plains stretched far and wide, its land was fertile, but its people were somewhat weak—so it was said.

sentences.zh: 者樂甸

translations.literal: Zheledian
translations.idiomatic: Zheledian

sentences.zh: 者樂甸，本馬龍他郎甸猛摩地，名者島。

translations.literal: Zheledian was originally the Mengmo territory of Malong Talangdian, named Zhedao.
translations.idiomatic: Zheledian was originally the Mengmo territory of Malong Talangdian, known as Zhedao.

sentences.zh: 洪武末內附，隸雲南布政司。

translations.literal: At the end of Hongwu [they] submitted to the interior and were subordinate to the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Hongwu reign the region submitted and was placed under the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年設者樂甸長官司，改隸雲南都司，以沐晟言其地廣人稠也。

translations.literal: In Yongle 1 the Zheledian Chief Office was established and changed to be subordinate to the Yunnan Regional Military Commission, as Mu Sheng reported its lands were broad and population dense.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 the Zheledian Chief Office was established and transferred to the Yunnan Regional Military Commission, on Mu Sheng's report that the territory was broad and densely populated.

sentences.zh: 十八年，長官刀談來朝，貢馬。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Chief Dao Tan came to court and presented tribute horses.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 Chief Dao Tan came to court with tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 自是，皆以刀氏世領司事。

translations.literal: From this time on, the Dao clan hereditarily held office affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the Dao clan held the office in hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 其地山險多瘴，介於鎮沅、元江、景東間。

translations.literal: Its territory was mountainous, perilous, and much afflicted by miasma, situated between Zhenyuan, Yuanjiang, and Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: The land was mountainous and malarial, lying between Zhenyuan, Yuanjiang, and Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 日事攻戰，鎧械犀利，兵寡而，諸部畏憚之。

translations.literal: Daily they engaged in warfare; armor and weapons were sharp; though troops were few they were fierce, and the various tribes feared them.
translations.idiomatic: They fought constantly; their arms were keen; though few in number their warriors were fierce, and neighboring tribes feared them.

sentences.zh: 茶山長官司

translations.literal: Chashan Chief Office
translations.idiomatic: Chashan Chief Office

sentences.zh: 茶山長官司，永樂二年頒給信符、金字紅牌。

translations.literal: Chashan Chief Office—in Yongle year 2 credentials and gold-letter red plaques were issued.
translations.idiomatic: The Chashan Chief Office received credentials and gold-letter red plaques in Yongle year 2.

sentences.zh: 八年，長官早張遣人貢馬。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Chief Zao Zhang sent men to present tribute horses.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Chief Zao Zhang sent tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年置滇灘巡檢司。

translations.literal: In Xuande year 5 the Dian Tan Inspection Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 5 the Dian Tan Inspection Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 以長官司奏滇灘當茶山瓦高之沖，蠻寇出沒，民不能安，通事段勝頗曉道理，能安人心，乞置司，以勝為巡檢。

translations.literal: Because the chief office memorialized that Dian Tan stood at the strategic point of Chashan Wagao, barbarian bandits appeared and disappeared, and the people could not be at peace; interpreter Duan Sheng was quite versed in reason and able to settle people's hearts; [they] begged to establish the commission and appoint Sheng as inspection commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The chief office reported that Dian Tan lay on the strategic route at Chashan Wagao, where tribal raiders came and went and the people lived in fear; interpreter Duan Sheng was prudent and able to reassure them, and they requested an inspection commission with Sheng as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: [The request] was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 孟璉

translations.literal: Menglian
translations.idiomatic: Menglian

sentences.zh: 〈（即猛臉）〉

translations.literal: (namely Mengmian)]〉
translations.idiomatic: (that is, Mengmian)]〉

sentences.zh: 孟璉長官司，永樂四年四月設。

translations.literal: The Menglian Chief Office was established in the fourth month of Yongle year 4.
translations.idiomatic: The Menglian Chief Office was established in the fourth month of Yongle year 4.

sentences.zh: 時孟璉頭目刀派送遣子壞罕來言，孟璉舊屬麓川平緬宣慰司，後隸孟定府。

translations.literal: At the time, Menglian headman Dao Paisong sent his son Huaihan to report that Menglian had formerly belonged to the Luchuan Pingmian Pacification Commission and later was subordinate to Mengding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Menglian headman Dao Paisong sent his son Huaihan to report that the district had once been under the Luchuan Pingmian Pacification Commission but had later been placed under Mengding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 而孟定知府刀名扛亦故平緬頭目，素與等夷，乞改隸。

translations.literal: The Mengding prefect Dao Mingkang was also a former Pingmian headman, had always been their equal, and begged to change [Menglian's] affiliation.
translations.idiomatic: Mengding Prefect Dao Mingkang was also a former Pingmian headman and their peer; he requested that Menglian's affiliation be changed.

sentences.zh: 遂設長官司，隸雲南都司，命刀派送為長官，賜冠帶、印章。

translations.literal: Thereupon a chief office was established, subordinate to the Yunnan Regional Military Commission; Dao Paisong was appointed chief and granted hat, belt, and seal.
translations.idiomatic: A chief office was then established under the Yunnan Regional Military Commission; Dao Paisong was made chief and given hat, belt, and seal.

sentences.zh: 正統四年，思任發反，以兵破孟璉，遂降於麓川，為木邦宣慰罕蓋法擊敗。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong year 4, Si Renfa rebelled, broke Menglian by force, and [Menglian] then submitted to Luchuan; it was defeated by Mobang Pacification Commissioner Hangaifa.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 4 Si Renfa rebelled, overran Menglian by force, and the district submitted to Luchuan before being defeated by Mobang commissioner Hangaifa.

sentences.zh: 七年，總督王驥征麓川，招降孟璉、亦保等寨。

translations.literal: In year 7, Grand Coordinator Wang Ji campaigned against Luchuan and induced Menglian, Yibao, and other stockades to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Grand Coordinator Wang Ji marched against Luchuan and won the surrender of Menglian, Yibao, and other stockades.

sentences.zh: 敕賜孟璉故長官司刀派罕子派樂等彩幣，以麓川平故也。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed colored silks on Pai Le and others, sons of the former Menglian chief Dao Paihan, because Luchuan had been pacified.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted colored silks to Pai Le and others, sons of the former Menglian chief Dao Paihan, in reward for the pacification of Luchuan.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，孟璉與孟養、孟密諸部仇殺數十年，司廢。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing era, Menglian and the various tribes of Mengyang and Mengmi feuded and killed one another for decades, and the office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign Menglian feuded with Mengyang, Mengmi, and other tribes for decades, and the office lapsed.

sentences.zh: 至萬歷十三年，隴川平，復設，稱猛臉雲。

translations.literal: By Wanli year 13, when Longchuan was pacified, [the office] was re-established; it was called Mengmian—or so it is said.
translations.idiomatic: By Wanli year 13, after Longchuan was pacified, the office was restored—known as Mengmian, it is said.

sentences.zh: 裏麻長官司

translations.literal: Liman Chief Office
translations.idiomatic: Liman Chief Office

sentences.zh: 裏麻長官司，永樂六年設，隸雲南都司，以刀思放為長官。

translations.literal: The Liman Chief Office was established in Yongle year 6, subordinate to the Yunnan Regional Military Commission, with Dao Sifang as chief.
translations.idiomatic: The Liman Chief Office was set up in Yongle year 6 under the Yunnan Regional Military Commission, with Dao Sifang as chief.

sentences.zh: 時思放為裏麻招剛。

translations.literal: At the time Sifang was the zhaogang of Liman.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Sifang held the tribal office of zhaogang in Liman.

sentences.zh: 招剛者，故西南蠻官名。

translations.literal: Zhaogang was an old southwestern tribal official title.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaogang was an old official title among the southwestern tribes.

sentences.zh: 思放籍其地來朝，請授職事，遂有是命，仍賜印章、冠帶。

translations.literal: Sifang registered his territory and came to court, requesting appointment to office; thereupon came this order, and he was further granted seal, hat, and belt.
translations.idiomatic: Sifang registered his lands and came to court seeking appointment; the order followed, and he received seal, hat, and belt.

sentences.zh: 八年遣頭目貢馬。

translations.literal: In year 8 he sent a headman to present tribute horses.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 a headman was sent with tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 鈕兀長官司

translations.literal: Niuwu Chief Office
translations.idiomatic: Niuwu Chief Office

sentences.zh: 鈕兀長官司，宣德八年置。

translations.literal: The Niuwu Chief Office was established in Xuande year 8.
translations.idiomatic: The Niuwu Chief Office was established in Xuande year 8.

sentences.zh: 鈕兀、五隆諸寨在和泥之地，其酋任者、陀比等朝貢至京，奏地遠蠻多，請授職以總其眾。

translations.literal: The stockades of Niuwu, Wulong, and others lay in the land of Heni; chieftains Renzhe, Tuobi, and others came to the capital with tribute and memorialized that the land was remote and tribes numerous, requesting appointments to command their people.
translations.idiomatic: Niuwu, Wulong, and other stockades lay in Heni country; chieftains Renzhe, Tuobi, and others came to court with tribute, reporting that their lands were remote and tribes numerous, and requesting office to command their people.

sentences.zh: 兵部請設長官司，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War requested establishment of a chief office; [the request] was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War recommended establishing a chief office, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 遂以任者為長官，陀比為副。

translations.literal: Renzhe was made chief and Tuobi deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Renzhe was appointed chief and Tuobi deputy.

sentences.zh: 東倘長官司

translations.literal: Dongdang Chief Office
translations.idiomatic: Dongdang Chief Office

sentences.zh: 東倘長官司，宣德八年置，隸緬甸宣慰。

translations.literal: The Dongdang Chief Office was established in Xuande year 8 and placed under the Burma Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Dongdang Chief Office was established in Xuande year 8 under the Burma Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 時緬甸宣慰昔得謀殺當蕩頭目新把的，而奪其地。

translations.literal: At the time, Burma Pacification Commissioner Xide had plotted to kill the Dangdang headman Xinbade and seized his territory.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Burma commissioner Xide had plotted to kill Dangdang headman Xinbade and seized his lands.

sentences.zh: 新把的遣子莽只貢象、馬、方物，乞置司，庶免侵殺，從之。

translations.literal: Xinbade sent his son Mangzhi with tribute elephants, horses, and local products, begging establishment of an office so as to avoid invasion and slaughter; [the request] was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Xinbade sent his son Mangzhi with elephants, horses, and local products as tribute, requesting an office to ward off invasion and killing; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 置東倘長官司，命新把的為長官。

translations.literal: The Dongdang Chief Office was established, and Xinbade was appointed chief.
translations.idiomatic: The Dongdang Chief Office was established with Xinbade as chief.

sentences.zh: 瓦甸長官司

translations.literal: Wadian Chief Office
translations.idiomatic: Wadian Chief Office

sentences.zh: 瓦甸長官司，初隸金齒，永樂九年改隸雲南都司。

translations.literal: The Wadian Chief Office was initially subordinate to Jinchi; in Yongle year 9 it was transferred to the Yunnan Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Wadian Chief Office was first under Jinchi; in Yongle year 9 it was transferred to the Yunnan Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 土官刀怕賴言金齒遠，都司近，故改隸焉。

translations.literal: The native official Dao Palai reported that Jinchi was distant while the Regional Military Commission was near, and so [the office] was transferred to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Native official Dao Palai said Jinchi was too far and the Regional Military Commission nearer, and the transfer was made for that reason.

sentences.zh: 宣德八年置曲石、高松坡、馬緬三巡檢司。

translations.literal: In Xuande year 8 the three inspection commissions of Qushi, Gaosongpo, and Mamian were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 8 three inspection commissions were established at Qushi, Gaosongpo, and Mamian.

sentences.zh: 初，長官司言其地山高林茂，寇盜出沒，人民不安，乞置巡檢司，以授通事楊資、楊中、範興三人，從之。

translations.literal: Initially the chief office reported that its territory was high in mountains and dense in forest, bandits appeared and disappeared, and the people were unsettled; [they] begged to establish inspection commissions and appoint interpreters Yang Zi, Yang Zhong, and Fan Xing to them; [the request] was granted.
translations.idiomatic: At first the chief office reported that the land was mountainous and forested, bandits roamed there, and the people lived in fear; they requested inspection commissions for interpreters Yang Zi, Yang Zhong, and Fan Xing, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 命資於曲石，中於高松坡，興於馬緬。

translations.literal: Zi was assigned to Qushi, Zhong to Gaosongpo, and Xing to Mamian.
translations.idiomatic: Zi was posted to Qushi, Zhong to Gaosongpo, and Xing to Mamian.

sentences.zh: 正統五年，長官早貴為思任發所獲，殺其守者十七人，挈家來歸。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong year 5, Chief Zaogui was captured by Si Renfa; he killed seventeen of his guards and brought his family to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 5 Chief Zaogui was taken by Si Renfa; he killed seventeen guards and fled with his family to submit.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其忠順，命所司褒賞，以早貴為安撫，賜彩幣、誥命。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his loyalty, ordered the responsible offices to reward him, made Zaogui a Pacification Commissioner, and bestowed colored silks and patent of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his loyalty, ordered official reward, appointed Zaogui pacification commissioner, and bestowed colored silks and a patent of appointment.

sentences.zh: 促瓦 散金二長官司

translations.literal: The Cuwa and Sanjin Chief Offices
translations.idiomatic: The Cuwa and Sanjin Chief Offices

sentences.zh: 促瓦、散金二長官司，皆永樂五年設，隸雲南都司。

translations.literal: The Cuwa and Sanjin chief offices were both established in Yongle year 5 and placed under the Yunnan Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Cuwa and Sanjin chief offices were both established in Yongle year 5 under the Yunnan Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 其地舊屬麓川，平緬。

translations.literal: Their territory had formerly belonged to Luchuan and Pingmian.
translations.idiomatic: Their lands had formerly belonged to Luchuan and Pingmian.

sentences.zh: 土蠻註甸八等來朝，請別設長官司，從之。

translations.literal: The tribal chieftain Zhudianba and others came to court and requested separate establishment of chief offices; [the request] was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal chieftain Zhudianba and others came to court seeking separate chief offices, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 命註甸八等為長官，各給印章。

translations.literal: Zhudianba and others were appointed chiefs, each given a seal.
translations.idiomatic: Zhudianba and others were made chiefs, each receiving a seal.

sentences.zh: 木邦

translations.literal: Mobang
translations.idiomatic: Mobang

sentences.zh: 〈（孟密安撫司附）〉

translations.literal: (attached to the Mengmi Pacification Commission)]〉
translations.idiomatic: (attached to the Mengmi Pacification Commission)]〉

sentences.zh: 木邦，一名孟邦。

translations.literal: Mobang, also called Mengbang.
translations.idiomatic: Mobang, also known as Mengbang.

sentences.zh: 元至元二十六年立木邦路軍民總管府，領三甸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan era of Yuan, the Mobang Circuit Military-Civilian General Directorate was established, governing three districts.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan year 26 of the Yuan the Mobang Circuit Military-Civilian General Directorate was established over three districts.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年平雲南，改木邦府。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 15, when Yunnan was pacified, [it] was changed to Mobang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunnan was pacified in Hongwu year 15, the region became Mobang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 建文末，土知府罕的法遣人貢馬及金銀器，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: At the end of the Jianwen reign, the native prefect Handaifa sent men to present tribute horses and gold and silver vessels; [they] were granted paper money.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Jianwen reign native prefect Handaifa sent tribute horses and gold and silver vessels, and paper money was granted in return.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年遣內官楊瑄賫敕諭木邦諸土官。

translations.literal: In Yongle 1, the inner court eunuch Yang Xuan was dispatched bearing an edict to instruct the various native officials of Mobang.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 the palace eunuch Yang Xuan was sent with an edict to the native officials of Mobang.

sentences.zh: 明年遣人來貢。

translations.literal: The next year they sent men to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The following year envoys came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 時麓川訴木邦侵地，命西平侯諭之，因改木邦為軍民宣慰使司，以知府罕的法為使，賜誥印。

translations.literal: At the time Luchuan complained that Mobang had encroached on its territory; the court ordered the Marquis of Xiping to instruct them; accordingly Mobang was changed to a Military-Civilian Pacification Commission, with Prefect Handaifa as commissioner, and patent and seal were granted.
translations.idiomatic: When Luchuan complained of Mobang encroachment, the Marquis of Xiping was ordered to mediate; Mobang was then made a Military-Civilian Pacification Commission with Prefect Handaifa as commissioner, and he received patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 時官軍征八百，罕的法發兵助戰，攻江下等十余寨，斬首五百余級。

translations.literal: At the time government troops were campaigning against Babai; Handaifa sent troops to aid in battle, attacked more than ten stockades including Jiangxia, and beheaded more than five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: While government troops campaigned against Babai, Handaifa sent forces to assist, stormed more than ten stockades including Jiangxia, and took more than five hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 詔遣鎮撫張伯恭、經歷唐復往賜白金、錦幣，及其部領有差。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Garrison Commissioner Zhang Bogong and Administrator Tang Fu to go and bestow white gold and brocade, with differentiated rewards for his subordinate leaders.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched Commissioner Zhang Bogong and Administrator Tang Fu to grant white gold and brocade, with graded rewards for his subordinates.

sentences.zh: 明年遣使貢象馬、方物，謝恩。

translations.literal: The next year envoys were sent with tribute elephants and horses and local products to express gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: The following year envoys came with elephants, horses, and local products to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 頒賜如例，復加賜其母及妻錦綺。

translations.literal: Distribution of gifts followed the usual practice, and brocades were additionally granted to his mother and wife.
translations.idiomatic: Gifts were distributed as usual, with additional brocades for his mother and wife.

sentences.zh: 罕的法卒，其子罕賓發來朝，請襲，命賜冠服。

translations.literal: Handaifa died; his son Hanbinfa came to court requesting succession; [the court] ordered grant of official robes.
translations.idiomatic: When Handaifa died his son Hanbinfa came to court to seek succession and was granted official robes.

sentences.zh: 七年遣使謝恩。

translations.literal: In year 7 envoys were sent to express gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 envoys came to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 又遣人奏緬甸宣慰使那羅塔數誘賓發叛，賓發不敢從逆，若天兵下臨，誓當效命。

translations.literal: Again men were sent to memorialize that Burma Pacification Commissioner Narata had repeatedly tempted Binfa to rebel; Binfa dared not join the rebellion, and if imperial troops descended, he vowed to serve loyally.
translations.idiomatic: He again sent word that Burma commissioner Narata had repeatedly tempted him to rebel, but he had refused; if imperial troops should come, he vowed to serve faithfully.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其忠，遣中官徐亮賫敕勞之，賜白金三千兩、錦綺三百表裏，祖母、母、妻織金文綺、紗羅各五十疋。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his loyalty, sent the eunuch Xu Liang bearing an edict of commendation, and granted three thousand taels of white gold, three hundred rolls of brocade, and fifty bolts each of gold-woven patterned brocade and gauze-silk to his grandmother, mother, and wife.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his loyalty and sent eunuch Xu Liang with an edict of commendation, granting three thousand taels of white gold, three hundred rolls of brocade, and fifty bolts each of gold-woven brocade and gauze-silk to his grandmother, mother, and wife.

sentences.zh: 自是，每三年遣使貢象馬。

translations.literal: From this time on, envoys were sent every three years with tribute elephants and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth tribute elephants and horses were sent every three years.

sentences.zh: 十一年，賓發遣使獻緬甸俘。

translations.literal: In year 11, Binfa sent envoys presenting Burma captives.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Binfa sent envoys with Burmese captives.

sentences.zh: 時木邦攻破緬甸城寨二十余，多所殺獲，獻於京師。

translations.literal: At the time Mobang had stormed more than twenty Burma walled stockades with many kills and captures, presented at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Mobang had stormed more than twenty Burmese walled stockades with heavy casualties and sent the captives to the capital.

sentences.zh: 宣德三年遣中官徐亮賫敕及文綺賜襲職宣慰罕門法並及祖母、母、妻。

translations.literal: In Xuande year 3 the eunuch Xu Liang was dispatched bearing an edict and patterned brocades to bestow on the succeeding Pacification Commissioner Hanmenfa and also his grandmother, mother, and wife.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 3 eunuch Xu Liang was sent with an edict and brocades for the succeeding commissioner Hanmenfa and his grandmother, mother, and wife.

sentences.zh: 八年，木邦與麓川、緬甸各爭地，訴於朝，帝命沐晟並三司巡按公勘。

translations.literal: In year 8, Mobang, Luchuan, and Burma each disputed territory and appealed to the court; the emperor ordered Mu Sheng together with the three provincial commissions and the touring censor to survey.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Mobang, Luchuan, and Burma appealed to court over border disputes; the emperor ordered Mu Sheng with the three commissions and touring censor to investigate.

sentences.zh: 正統三年征麓川，敕諭木邦以兵會剿。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong year 3, campaigning against Luchuan, an edict instructed Mobang to join forces for the joint strike.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 3, when Luchuan was attacked, an edict ordered Mobang to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 五年，總兵官沐昂遣人間道達木邦，得報，知宣慰祖母美罕板、其孫宣慰罕蓋法與麓川戰於孟定、孟璉地，殺部長二十人，斬首三萬余級，獲馬象器械甚眾。

translations.literal: In year 5, Regional Commander Mu Ang sent men by secret route to reach Mobang, received report, learning that the Pacification Commissioner's grandmother Mei Hanban and her grandson Pacification Commissioner Hangaifa had fought Luchuan at Mengding and Menglian territory, killed twenty tribal heads, beheaded more than thirty thousand, and captured horses, elephants, weapons, and equipment in great number.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Regional Commander Mu Ang sent men by a secret route to Mobang and learned that commissioner Hangaifa and his grandmother Mei Hanban had fought Luchuan in Mengding and Menglian, killing twenty tribal chiefs, taking more than thirty thousand heads, and capturing large numbers of horses, elephants, weapons, and equipment.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其功，加授罕蓋法懷遠將軍，封美罕板太淑人，賚以金帶、彩幣。

translations.literal: The emperor commended their merit, additionally appointed Hangaifa General Who Cherishes the Distant, ennobled Mei Hanban as Lady Tashu, and bestowed gold belt and colored silks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised their achievement, additionally appointing Hangaifa General Who Cherishes the Distant, ennobling Mei Hanban as Lady Tashu, and granting gold belt and colored silks.

sentences.zh: 七年，總督王驥奏，罕蓋法遣兵攻拔麓川板罕、貢章等寨，追至孟蒙，獲其孥七人，象十二，麓川酋思任發父子遁孟廣。

translations.literal: In year 7, Grand Coordinator Wang Ji memorialized that Hangaifa sent troops to storm Luchuan stockades Banhan, Gongzhang, and others, pursued to Mengmeng, captured seven of their wives and children and twelve elephants; Luchuan chieftain Si Renfa and his son fled to Mengguang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Grand Coordinator Wang Ji reported that Hangaifa sent troops against Luchuan stockades Banhan, Gongzhang, and others, pursued them to Mengmeng, captured seven family members and twelve elephants, and that Luchuan chieftain Si Renfa and his son fled to Mengguang.

sentences.zh: 帝命指揮陳儀往勞之，且曰：「木邦能自效，生縶賊首獻，其酬以麓川土地人民。」

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Commander Chen Yi to go commend them, and furthermore said: "If Mobang can serve effectively of its own accord, and captures the rebel leaders alive for presentation, it shall be rewarded with Luchuan's lands and people."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Commander Chen Yi to go commend them and said: "If Mobang can serve on its own, capture rebel leaders alive and present them, it shall be rewarded with Luchuan's lands and people."

sentences.zh: 八年免木邦歲辦金萬四千兩。

translations.literal: In year 8 Mobang was exempted from the annual tribute of fourteen thousand taels of gold.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Mobang was exempted from its annual tribute levy of fourteen thousand taels of gold.

sentences.zh: 木邦遣人謝恩，並獻所獲思任發家屬，復賜敕及彩幣獎勞。

translations.literal: Mobang sent men to express gratitude and also presented the Si Renfa family members they had captured; edicts and colored silks were again granted in commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Mobang sent envoys to give thanks and presented the Si Renfa family members they had captured; edicts and colored silks were again granted in reward.

sentences.zh: 十一年，緬甸獻任發首，木邦亦遣使與同獻，且修貢職，因求麓川地。

translations.literal: In year 11, Burma presented Renfa's head; Mobang also sent envoys to present it jointly, resumed tribute duties, and requested Luchuan territory.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Burma presented Renfa's head; Mobang also sent envoys to join in the presentation, resumed tribute duties, and requested Luchuan territory.

sentences.zh: 兵部以麓川已設隴川宣撫司，請以孟止地給之，並遣官諭祭其母，以表忠勤，免木邦歲辦銀八錠三年，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War, since Luchuan had already had the Longchuan Pacification Commission established, requested that Mengzhi territory be granted to them, and also that officials be dispatched to perform rites of sacrifice for his mother to express gratitude for loyalty and diligence; Mobang was exempt from the annual silver levy of eight ingots for three years; [the request] was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War, since the Longchuan Pacification Commission had already been established in Luchuan, recommended granting Mengzhi territory to Mobang and dispatching officials to perform sacrificial rites for his mother in recognition of his loyalty; Mobang was exempted from its annual silver levy of eight ingots for three years, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 暴泰元年，罕蓋法奏乞隴川界者闌景線地，未服，蓋法子罕落法輒發兵據之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baotai, Hangaifa memorialized begging for the Zhanjingxian territory on the Longchuan border; [the court] had not yet assented, but Hangaifa's son Hanluofa rashly sent troops to occupy it.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 1 Hangaifa requested the Zhanjingxian borderlands from Longchuan; before approval came, his son Hanluofa sent troops to seize them.

sentences.zh: 隴川宣撫刀歪孟訴於總兵官沐璘。

translations.literal: Longchuan Pacification Commissioner Daowaimeng appealed to Regional Commander Mu Lin.
translations.idiomatic: Longchuan Pacification Commissioner Daowaimeng appealed to Regional Commander Mu Lin.

sentences.zh: 璘遣使諭歸之，而與以底麻之地。

translations.literal: Lin sent envoys instructing [Hanluofa] to return it, and granted Dimadi territory in exchange.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Lin sent envoys ordering its return and granted Dimadi land in compensation.

sentences.zh: 四年，罕落法襲父職。

translations.literal: In year 4, Hanluofa inherited his father's office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 Hanluofa inherited his father's office.

sentences.zh: 族人構難，落法避於孟更，遣人赴總兵官求救。

translations.literal: Clansmen stirred up trouble; Luofa took refuge at Menggeng and sent men to the regional commander begging rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Kinsmen fomented trouble; Luofa fled to Menggeng and sent to the regional commander for aid.

sentences.zh: 璘以聞，詔左參將胡誌調兵撫諭之，與其族人部眾設盟而還。

translations.literal: Lin reported it; an edict ordered Left Assistant Commander Hu Zhi to mobilize troops to pacify and instruct them; he made covenant with the clansmen and their followers and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Lin reported to court; Assistant Commander Hu Zhi was ordered to mobilize troops and mediate; he made covenant with the clansmen and their forces and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 然落法猶避居孟都不敢歸。

translations.literal: Yet Luofa still took refuge at Mengdu and dared not return.
translations.idiomatic: But Luofa still remained at Mengdu and would not go back.

sentences.zh: 孟都蠻者，地近隴川，歲調蠻兵二百更番護之。

translations.literal: Mengdu was a tribal settlement; its territory was near Longchuan, and two hundred tribal soldiers were rotated yearly to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: Mengdu was a tribal settlement near Longchuan; two hundred tribal soldiers were stationed there in rotation each year.

sentences.zh: 天順元年，鎮守中官羅珪奏：「罕落法與所部交攻，遣人求援。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun, Garrison Eunuch Luo Gui memorialized: "Hanluofa and his subordinates are attacking each other; men have been sent begging aid.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 1 Garrison Eunuch Luo Gui memorialized: "Hanluofa and his subordinates are fighting one another and have sent for aid.

sentences.zh: 臣等議委南寧伯毛勝、都督胡誌量調官軍，相機剿捕。」

translations.literal: We ministers propose assigning Nanning Earl Mao Sheng and Commander-in-Chief Hu Zhi to mobilize government troops as circumstances warrant to suppress and capture them."
translations.idiomatic: We propose assigning Nanning Earl Mao Sheng and Commander-in-Chief Hu Zhi to mobilize government troops as circumstances warrant to suppress them."

sentences.zh: 帝以非犯邊疆，不許。

translations.literal: The emperor, because [this] was not a border violation, did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, finding that the frontier had not been violated, refused.

sentences.zh: 二年，落法奏為思坑、曩罕弄等所攻，乞兵剿除，命總兵官區處。

translations.literal: In year 2, Luofa memorialized that he was attacked by Sikeng, Nang Hannong, and others, begged troops to suppress them; the regional commander was ordered to handle it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 Luofa reported attack by Sikeng, Nang Hannong, and others and requested troops; the regional commander was ordered to deal with it.

sentences.zh: 六年，總兵官沐瓚奏罕落法屢侵隴川地，欲以撥守貴州兵八千調回防禦，詔留其半。

translations.literal: In year 6, Regional Commander Mu Zan memorialized that Hanluofa repeatedly encroached on Longchuan territory and wished to recall eight thousand Guizhou troops stationed there for defense; an edict kept half of them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 Mu Zan reported Hanluofa's repeated encroachments on Longchuan and a plan to recall eight thousand Guizhou garrison troops; an edict ordered half to remain.

sentences.zh: 成化十年，木邦所轄孟密蠻婦曩罕弄等侵掠隴川，黔國公沐琮以聞。

translations.literal: In Chenghua year 10, Nang Hannong, a Mengmi tribal woman under Mobang's jurisdiction, and others raided Longchuan; Duke of Qian Mu Cong reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 10 Nang Hannong, a Mengmi tribal woman under Mobang, raided Longchuan; Duke of Qian Mu Cong reported it.

sentences.zh: 曩罕弄者，故木邦宣慰罕揲法之女，嫁其孟密部長思外法。

translations.literal: Nang Hannong was the daughter of the former Mobang Pacification Commissioner Hanyefai; she married the Mengmi tribal headman Siwaifa.
translations.idiomatic: Nang Hannong was the daughter of former Mobang commissioner Hanyefai; she had married the Mengmi tribal headman Siwaifa.

sentences.zh: 地有寶井。

translations.literal: The territory had precious mines.
translations.idiomatic: The territory held precious mines.

sentences.zh: 罕揲法卒，孫落法嗣。

translations.literal: When Hanyefai died, grandson Luofa succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Hanyefai died his grandson Luofa succeeded.

sentences.zh: 曩罕弄以尊屬不樂受節制，嗾族人與爭。

translations.literal: Nang Hannong, as an elder relative, was displeased to accept control; she incited clansmen to contest [with Mobang].
translations.idiomatic: As a senior kinswoman, Nang Hannong resented Mobang's authority and incited her clansmen to fight.

sentences.zh: 景泰中，叛木邦，逐宣慰，據公署，殺掠鄰境隴川、孟養，兵力日盛，自稱天娘子，其子思柄自稱宣慰。

translations.literal: In the Jingtai era she rebelled against Mobang, drove out the Pacification Commissioner, occupied the official yamen, slaughtered and raided neighboring Longchuan and Mengyang; her military strength grew daily; she styled herself Lady of Heaven, and her son Sibing styled himself Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: During Jingtai she rebelled against Mobang, expelled the commissioner, seized the yamen, and raided Longchuan and Mengyang; her power grew until she styled herself Lady of Heaven and her son Sibing called himself pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 黔國公琮奏委三司官往撫，曩罕弄驕蹇不服，且欲外結交址兵，逼脅木邦、八百諸部，琮等復以聞。

translations.literal: Duke of Qian Cong memorialized commissioning officials of the three commissions to go pacify; Nang Hannong was proud and obstinate and would not submit, and moreover wished to ally outwardly with Annamese troops, coercing Mobang, Babai, and other tribes; Cong and others again reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Mu Cong sent three-commission officials to pacify her, but Nang Hannong was arrogant and defiant and sought alliance with Annam, threatening Mobang, Babai, and other tribes; Cong reported again.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書張鵬主用兵。

translations.literal: Minister of War Zhang Peng advocated using troops.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Zhang Peng favored military action.

sentences.zh: 詔廷臣集議，皆以孟密與木邦仇殺，並未侵犯邊境，止宜撫諭。

translations.literal: An edict convened court ministers for deliberation; all agreed that Mengmi and Mobang were feuding and killing one another and had not violated the border; pacification and instruction alone were appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The court convened; all agreed Mengmi and Mobang were at feud and had not violated the frontier, so mediation alone was warranted.

sentences.zh: 因命副都御史程宗馳傳與譯者序班蘇銓往。

translations.literal: Accordingly Vice Censor-in-Chief Cheng Zong was ordered to go swiftly with bearer of edict and interpreter Prefect Su Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief Cheng Zong and interpreter Prefect Su Quan were dispatched on urgent mission.

sentences.zh: 時成化十八年也。

translations.literal: This was Chenghua year 18.
translations.idiomatic: This was Chenghua year 18.

sentences.zh: 逾年，孟密思柄遣人入貢，宴賜如土官例。

translations.literal: The following year, Mengmi's Sibing sent men to offer tribute; feasting and grants followed the native-official precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Mengmi's Sibing sent tribute envoys, who were feasted and rewarded according to native-official precedent.

sentences.zh: 已，孟密奏為木邦所擾，乞別設安撫司。

translations.literal: Before long, Mengmi memorialized that it was harassed by Mobang and begged separate establishment of a Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Mengmi reported harassment by Mobang and requested a separate Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 張鵬以太監覃平、御史程宗撫馭已有成緒，遂命宗巡撫雲南，敕平偕詣金齒勸諭之，其孟密地或仍隸木邦，或別設安撫，區處具奏。

translations.literal: Zhang Peng, because the eunuch Tan Ping and Censor Cheng Zong's pacification had already achieved results, then ordered Cheng to tour Yunnan, instructing Ping to go together to Jinchi to advise and instruct them; whether Mengmi territory should remain under Mobang or a separate Pacification Commission be established was to be handled and fully memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Peng, finding that eunuch Tan Ping and Censor Cheng Zong had already made progress in pacification, ordered Cheng to tour Yunnan and instructed Ping to go with him to Jinchi to advise them; whether Mengmi should remain under Mobang or receive a separate Pacification Commission was to be settled and fully reported.

sentences.zh: 初，曩罕弄竊據孟密，貳於木邦。

translations.literal: Initially, Nang Hannong had stealthily seized Mengmi and was duplicitous toward Mobang.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset Nang Hannong had seized Mengmi by stealth and turned against Mobang.

sentences.zh: 畏鄰境不平，遣人從間道抵雲南，至京，獻寶石、黃金，乞開設治所，直隸布政司。

translations.literal: Fearing unrest in neighboring territories, she sent men by secret routes to Yunnan, then to the capital, offering precious stones and gold, begging establishment of an administrative seat directly subordinate to the Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Fearful of trouble on her borders, she sent envoys by back trails to Yunnan and then the capital with precious stones and gold, requesting a new administrative seat under the provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 閣臣萬安欲許之，劉珝、劉吉皆以孟養原木邦屬夷，今曩罕弄叛，而請命於朝，若許之，則土官誰不解體。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Wan An wished to grant it; Liu Yu and Liu Ji both held that Mengmi had originally been tribal territory subordinate to Mobang—now Nang Hannong had rebelled yet sought appointment from the court; if granted, which native official would not fall apart?
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Wan An favored approval, but Liu Yu and Liu Ji argued that Mengmi had originally been tribal domain under Mobang; to grant office to a rebel who now petitioned the court would unravel every native chieftain's allegiance.

sentences.zh: 蘇銓私以告於宗。

translations.literal: Su Quan privately informed Cheng Zong of this.
translations.idiomatic: Su Quan told Cheng Zong in private.

sentences.zh: 宗復奏曩罕弄與木邦仇殺已久，勢難再合，已喻諸蠻，示以朝廷德意，宥其罪，開設衙門，令還其所侵地，皆踴躍奉命，木邦亦已允服，乞遂行之。

translations.literal: Cheng Zong memorialized again that Nang Hannong and Mobang had been feuding and killing for a long time and could hardly reunite; he had already instructed the various tribes, showing them the court's benevolent intent, pardoning their crimes, establishing a yamen, and ordering return of seized lands—all leapt to obey, Mobang had also submitted, and he begged immediate implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zong reported again that Nang Hannong and Mobang had feuded too long to reunite; he had already instructed the tribes in the court's benevolent intent, pardoned their offenses, established a yamen, and ordered return of seized lands—all had eagerly accepted, and Mobang had submitted as well; he asked that the plan proceed at once.

sentences.zh: 部覆，從之。

translations.literal: The ministry replied and assented.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved.

sentences.zh: 二十年遂設孟密安撫司，以思柄為使。

translations.literal: In year 20 the Mengmi Pacification Commission was accordingly established, with Sibing as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 the Mengmi Pacification Commission was established and Sibing made commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時孟密據寶井之利，資為結納，而木邦為孟密所侵，兵力積弱，不能報，雖屢奏訴，竟不得直雲。

translations.literal: At the time Mengmi held the profits of the precious mines and used them to win allies; Mobang, invaded by Mengmi, grew ever weaker in military strength and could not retaliate; though it repeatedly memorialized appeals, it never obtained justice in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Mengmi controlled the precious mines and used the wealth to buy allies; Mobang, harried by Mengmi, grew progressively weaker and could not strike back; though it petitioned again and again, it never obtained redress in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年，雲南守臣奏，孟密曩罕弄先後占奪木邦地二十七處，又誘其頭目放卓孟等叛，其勢必盡吞後已。

translations.literal: In Hongzhi year 2, Yunnan garrison officials memorialized that Mengmi's Nang Hannong had successively seized twenty-seven places of Mobang territory, and moreover enticed its headmen Fang Zhuomeng and others to rebel—their power would surely swallow Mobang entirely afterward.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 2 Yunnan officials reported that Nang Hannong of Mengmi had seized twenty-seven Mobang districts and incited headmen such as Fang Zhuomeng to rebel, threatening to consume Mobang entirely.

sentences.zh: 乞敕八百宣慰司俾與木邦和好，互相救援。

translations.literal: They begged an edict to the Babai Pacification Commission to make peace with Mobang and rescue each other.
translations.idiomatic: They requested orders that Babai make peace with Mobang and aid each other in emergencies.

sentences.zh: 亦敕木邦宣慰收復人心，親愛骨肉，勿使孟密得乘間誘叛，自致孤弱。

translations.literal: Also instruct the Mobang Pacification Commissioner to recover people's hearts, cherish kinsmen, and not let Mengmi exploit openings to entice rebellion and bring isolation and weakness on himself.
translations.idiomatic: Mobang's commissioner was also to win back loyalty, cherish his kin, and deny Mengmi any opening to lure defections and leave him isolated.

sentences.zh: 如孟密聽諭，方許曩罕弄孫承襲。

translations.literal: Only if Mengmi heeded instructions would Nang Hannong's grandson be allowed to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Nang Hannong's grandson would be permitted to inherit office only if Mengmi submitted to mediation.

sentences.zh: 報可，並敕雲南守臣親詣金齒曉諭，復降敕詰責前鎮巡官所以受賂召侮啟釁者。

translations.literal: Approval was returned; Yunnan garrison officials were also ordered to go personally to Jinchi to proclaim instructions, and an edict was again sent rebuking former garrison and touring officials for accepting bribes, inviting contempt, and provoking conflict.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved; Yunnan officials were ordered to Jinchi in person to announce the policy, and edicts rebuked former garrison and touring officials for taking bribes, inviting insult, and sparking conflict.

sentences.zh: 三年追論致仕南京工部尚書程宗罪。

translations.literal: In year 3, the retired Nanjing Minister of Works Cheng Zong's crimes were pursued for judgment.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 the court moved to punish Cheng Zong, retired minister of works at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 先是，宗以右副都御史奉命率蘇銓往撫諭，而銓受思柄金，紿宗奏為設孟密安撫司。

translations.literal: Earlier, Cheng Zong as Vice Censor-in-Chief had been ordered to lead Su Quan to pacify and instruct; Su Quan accepted gold from Sibing and deceived Cheng Zong into memorializing to establish the Mengmi Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Cheng Zong, as vice censor-in-chief, had been sent with Su Quan to mediate; Su Quan took bribes from Sibing and tricked Cheng into memorializing for a Mengmi pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 銓復教思柄偽歸木邦地，而占據如故，思柄益橫。

translations.literal: Quan further instructed Sibing to feign restoring Mobang lands while occupying them as before; Sibing grew all the more overbearing.
translations.idiomatic: Quan also coached Sibing to pretend to return Mobang territory while keeping his holdings; Sibing grew bolder still.

sentences.zh: 至是，木邦宣慰罕挖法發其事，時宗已致仕，巡按請追罪之。

translations.literal: At this point Mobang Pacification Commissioner Han Wafa exposed the matter; Cheng Zong had already retired, and the touring censor requested pursuit of punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Then Mobang commissioner Han Wafa exposed the affair; Cheng Zong had already retired, and the touring censor asked that he be punished.

sentences.zh: 獄具，帝以事在赦前，不問。

translations.literal: When the case was complete, the emperor, because the matter fell before an amnesty, did not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: The case was complete, but the emperor declined to act because the offenses predated an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 六年，雲南守臣奏孟密侵奪木邦，兵連禍結，垂四十余年，屢撫屢叛，勢愈猖肆，請調兵往討。

translations.literal: In year 6, Yunnan garrison officials memorialized that Mengmi encroached on and seized Mobang; war and disaster had continued nearly forty years, with repeated pacification and rebellion, growing ever more rampant—they requested troops for a punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 Yunnan officials reported forty years of Mengmi aggression against Mobang, repeated mediation and rebellion, and ever bolder raids; they requested a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 兵部議以孟密安撫，初隸布政司，今改隸木邦，以致爭殺，仍如初隸可息兵，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated that since the Mengmi Pacification Commission had initially been subordinate to the Provincial Administration Commission and its reassignment to Mobang had caused feuding and killing, restoring the original subordination could cease hostilities; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The war ministry ruled that Mengmi's pacification commission, originally under the provincial administration commission, had been reassigned to Mobang with bloody results; restoring the original arrangement would end the fighting, and this was approved.

sentences.zh: 初，孟密之復叛木邦也，因木邦宣慰罕挖法親迎婦於孟乃寨，孟密土舍思揲乘虛襲之，據木邦，誘降其頭目高答落等，聚兵阻路。

translations.literal: Initially, when Mengmi again rebelled against Mobang, it was because Mobang Pacification Commissioner Han Wafa had gone in person to fetch his bride at Mengnai Stockade; Mengmi's tribal officer Sishe seized the opportunity to attack, occupied Mobang, enticed its headmen Gaodala and others to surrender, and massed troops to block the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Mengmi rebelled again when Han Wafa went to Mengnai Stockade to fetch his bride; the Mengmi officer Sishe struck at the opening, seized Mobang, won over headmen including Gaodala, and blocked the roads with troops.

sentences.zh: 罕挖法不得歸，依孟乃寨者三年。

translations.literal: Han Wafa could not return and relied on Mengnai Stockade for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Han Wafa was cut off from home and took refuge at Mengnai Stockade for three years.

sentences.zh: 於是巡撫張誥等會奏，議遣文武大員詣孟密撫諭，思揲猶不服。

translations.literal: Thereupon Grand Coordinator Zhang Hao and others jointly memorialized, deliberating dispatch of high civil and military officers to Mengmi for pacification and instruction; Sishe still would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhang Hao and colleagues proposed sending senior civil and military officers to negotiate with Mengmi, but Sishe remained defiant.

sentences.zh: 誥乃遣官督率隴川、南甸、幹崖三宣撫司，積糧開道，示以必征之勢，又令漢土官舍耀兵以威之。

translations.literal: Hao then dispatched officials to supervise Longchuan, Nandian, and Ganyai Pacification Commissions to accumulate grain and open roads, displaying the certainty of a punitive expedition; he also ordered the Han-native official She to muster troops to overawe them.
translations.idiomatic: Hao sent officers to mobilize Longchuan, Nandian, and Ganyai, stockpiled supplies, and cleared roads to signal imminent invasion; he also ordered the native official She to parade troops as a show of force.

sentences.zh: 高答落等懼，謀歸罕挖法。

translations.literal: Gaodala and others feared this and plotted to return to Han Wafa.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing this, Gaodala and his fellows planned to go back to Han Wafa.

sentences.zh: 思揲欲殺之，罕挖法乞救於鄰部，調土兵合隴川等三宣撫兵至蠻遮，共圍之。

translations.literal: Sishe wished to kill them; Han Wafa begged rescue from neighboring tribes, mobilizing tribal soldiers together with the three pacification commissions' troops to Manzhe, jointly besieging them.
translations.idiomatic: Sishe moved to kill them; Han Wafa appealed to neighboring tribes and mustered tribal and Longchuan-allied troops to Manzhe to besiege him.

sentences.zh: 思揲懼，乃罷兵。

translations.literal: Sishe grew afraid and thereupon dismissed his troops.
translations.idiomatic: Sishe, alarmed, stood down.

sentences.zh: 誥等奏其事，且乞賞有功者。

translations.literal: Hao and others memorialized the affair and also begged rewards for the meritorious.
translations.idiomatic: Hao reported the outcome and asked that the meritorious be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 兵部議，罕挖法雖還木邦，思揲猶未悔罪，必令歃血同盟，歸地獻叛，永息爭端，乃可論功行賞，報聞。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated that though Han Wafa had returned to Mobang, Sishe had not yet repented his crimes; they must be made to oath by blood in alliance, return lands and surrender rebels, and permanently cease the dispute—only then could merit be discussed and rewards granted; acknowledgment was reported.
translations.idiomatic: The war ministry replied that although Han Wafa had regained Mobang, Sishe had not yet atoned; they must swear a blood oath, restore lands, surrender rebels, and settle the feud before rewards could be granted.

sentences.zh: 九年，罕挖法及思揲各遣使來貢，報賜如例。

translations.literal: In year 9, Han Wafa and Sishe each sent envoys to offer tribute; responsive grants followed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 both Han Wafa and Sishe sent tribute envoys and received customary gifts in return.

sentences.zh: 初，思揲圍蠻遮，木邦宣慰妻求救於孟養思陸。

translations.literal: Initially, when Sishe besieged Manzhe, the Mobang Pacification Commissioner's wife begged aid from Mengyang's Si Lu.
translations.idiomatic: When Sishe besieged Manzhe, the Mobang commissioner's wife appealed to Si Lu of Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 孟密素畏思陸之兵，聞其將至，遂解去。

translations.literal: Mengmi had always feared Si Lu's troops; hearing he was about to arrive, they thereupon lifted the siege and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Mengmi had long feared Si Lu's army and broke off the siege at word of his approach.

sentences.zh: 木邦與思陸謀共取孟密，於是蠻中之患，又在孟養矣。

translations.literal: Mobang and Si Lu plotted jointly to seize Mengmi; thus the trouble among the tribes shifted again to Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Mobang and Si Lu then plotted to take Mengmi together, and the frontier trouble moved to Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 自萬安、程宗勘處失宜，諸酋長紛紜進退，中國用兵且數十年。

translations.literal: From Wan An's and Cheng Zong's mishandling of investigation and disposition, chieftains came and went in confusion, and the Chinese empire used troops for nearly decades.
translations.idiomatic: From Wan An's and Cheng Zong's mishandling, chieftains shifted allegiance in chaos, and the court kept armies in the field for decades.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，思陸子思倫與木邦宣慰罕烈同擊殺緬酋莽紀歲，而分其地。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiajing, Si Lu's son Si Lun and Mobang Pacification Commissioner Han Lie jointly attacked and killed the Burmese chieftain Mang Jisui and divided his territory.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiajing, Si Lun, son of Si Lu, and Mobang commissioner Han Lie jointly killed the Burmese chief Mang Jisui and divided his lands.

sentences.zh: 後莽瑞體強，將修怨於木邦。

translations.literal: Later Mang Ruiti grew strong and was about to renew grievances against Mobang.
translations.idiomatic: Later Mang Ruiti grew powerful and prepared to settle old scores with Mobang.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年，木邦土舍罕拔告襲，有司索賂不為請。

translations.literal: In Longqing year 2, Mobang tribal officer Han Ba reported an impending attack; local officials demanded bribes and did not petition on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing year 2 Han Ba of Mobang reported an imminent attack, but local officials extorted bribes and refused to petition for him.

sentences.zh: 拔怒，與弟罕章集兵梗往來道，商旅不前，而己食鹽亦乏絕，乞於緬。

translations.literal: Ba, enraged, gathered troops with his brother Han Zhang to block the travel routes; merchants dared not advance, and his own salt supplies were also exhausted; he begged Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Ba and his brother Han Zhang blockaded the trade routes; traffic halted and salt ran out; he turned to Burma for help.

sentences.zh: 緬以五千籯饋之，自是反德緬，攜金寶象馬往謝之。

translations.literal: Burma sent him five thousand baskets in gift; from then he turned his gratitude toward Burma and went bearing gold, treasures, elephants, and horses to thank them.
translations.idiomatic: Burma sent five thousand baskets of supplies; Ba then switched allegiance, carrying gold, treasures, elephants, and horses to thank them.

sentences.zh: 瑞體亦厚報之，歡甚，約為父子。

translations.literal: Ruiti also responded lavishly; they rejoiced greatly and pledged a father-son bond.
translations.idiomatic: Ruiti repaid him generously; delighted, they pledged a bond like father and son.

sentences.zh: 瑞體死，子應裏用嶽鳳言誘拔殺之。

translations.literal: When Ruiti died, his son Ying Li, using Yue Feng's advice, lured Ba and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: After Ruiti died, his son Ying Li, heeding Yue Feng, lured Han Ba to his death.

sentences.zh: 時萬歷十一年也。

translations.literal: This was Wanli year 11.
translations.idiomatic: This was Wanli year 11.

sentences.zh: 拔子進忠守木邦，應裏遣弟應龍襲之，其孽子罕鳳與耿馬舍人罕虔欲擒進忠獻應龍。

translations.literal: Ba's son Jinzhong held Mobang; Ying Li sent his younger brother Ying Long to attack; the bastard son Han Feng and Gengma officer Han Qian wished to capture Jinzhong and present him to Ying Long.
translations.idiomatic: Jinzhong, Ba's son, held Mobang; Ying Li sent Ying Long to attack; the illegitimate son Han Feng and Gengma officer Han Qian plotted to seize Jinzhong for Ying Long.

sentences.zh: 進忠攜妻子內奔，虔等追至姚關，焚順寧而去。

translations.literal: Jinzhong fled inland with wife and children; Qian and others pursued to Yaoguan, burned Shunning, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Jinzhong fled inland with his family; Qian's party pursued to Yaoguan, burned Shunning, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十二年，官軍破緬於姚關，立其子欽。

translations.literal: In year 12, government troops defeated Burma at Yaoguan and installed his son Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 imperial troops routed the Burmese at Yaoguan and enthroned Qin, his son.

sentences.zh: 欽死，其叔罕𧛾約暹羅攻緬，緬恨之。

translations.literal: When Qin died, his uncle Han He allied with Siam to attack Burma; Burma bore hatred for this.
translations.idiomatic: After Qin died, his uncle Han He allied with Siam against Burma, which never forgave the betrayal.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，緬以三十萬眾圍其城。

translations.literal: In year 34, Burma with three hundred thousand men besieged their city.
translations.idiomatic: In year 34 three hundred thousand Burmese troops besieged the city.

sentences.zh: 請救於內地，不至，城陷，罕𧛾被擄。

translations.literal: They begged rescue from the interior but none came; the city fell and Han He was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Appeals for help from the interior went unanswered; the city fell and Han He was taken.

sentences.zh: 緬偽立孟密思禮領其眾。

translations.literal: Burma falsely installed Mengmi's Si Li to command their multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Burma placed Mengmi's Si Li in nominal command of the people.

sentences.zh: 事聞，黜總兵官陳賓，木邦遂亡。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Regional Commander Chen Bin was dismissed, and Mobang was thereby lost.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached court, regional commander Chen Bin was dismissed; Mobang was lost.

sentences.zh: 孟密自思柄授安撫，繼之者曰思揲，曰思真，真年至百十歲。

translations.literal: From Sibing receiving the pacification commission, successors were called Sishe and Sizhen; Zhen lived to one hundred ten years.
translations.idiomatic: After Sibing received the pacification commission, Sishe and then Sizhen succeeded him; Sizhen lived to one hundred ten.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，土舍兄弟爭襲，走訴於緬。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing era, tribal officer brothers contended for succession and fled to plead with Burma.
translations.idiomatic: During Jiajing, rival brothers fought over succession and appealed to Burma.

sentences.zh: 緬人為立其弟，改名思忠，忠遂以其地附緬。

translations.literal: The Burmese installed his younger brother, renamed Si Zhong; Zhong then attached his territory to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese installed his younger brother as Si Zhong, who then submitted the territory to Burma.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十二年，忠賫偽印來歸，命授為宣撫。

translations.literal: In Wanli year 12, Zhong came to submit carrying a false seal and was ordered appointed Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 12 Zhong returned with a forged seal and was appointed pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 已而復投緬，乃以其母罕烘代掌司印。

translations.literal: Before long he again went over to Burma; his mother Han Hong was then placed to hold the commission seal in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: He soon defected to Burma again, and his mother Han Hong was left to hold the commission seal.

sentences.zh: 緬攻孟密，罕烘率子思禮、從子思仁奔孟廣，而孟密遂失。

translations.literal: When Burma attacked Mengmi, Han Hong led her son Si Li and nephew Si Ren to flee to Mengguang, and Mengmi was thereby lost.
translations.idiomatic: When Burma attacked Mengmi, Han Hong fled with Si Li and her nephew Si Ren to Mengguang, and Mengmi fell.

sentences.zh: 十八年，緬復攻孟廣，罕烘、思禮奔隴川，思仁奔工回，而孟廣又失。

translations.literal: In year 18, Burma again attacked Mengguang; Han Hong and Si Li fled to Longchuan, Si Ren fled to Gonghui, and Mengguang was again lost.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 Burma struck Mengguang again; Han Hong and Si Li fled to Longchuan and Si Ren to Gonghui, and Mengguang too was lost.

sentences.zh: 先是，思仁從罕烘奔孟廣時，有甘線姑者，思忠妻也。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Si Ren followed Han Hong fleeing to Mengguang, there was one Gan Xiangu, wife of Si Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: When Si Ren had fled to Mengguang with Han Hong, Si Zhong's wife Gan Xiangu was among them.

sentences.zh: 思忠既投緬，思仁通於線姑，遂欲妻之，而罕烘不許。

translations.literal: After Si Zhong had gone over to Burma, Si Ren consorted with Xiangu and then wished to marry her, but Han Hong would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: After Si Zhong joined Burma, Si Ren began an affair with Xiangu and sought to marry her, but Han Hong refused.

sentences.zh: 至是，罕烘攜線姑走隴川，思仁奔雅蓋，率兵象犯隴川，欲擄線姑去。

translations.literal: At this point Han Hong fled to Longchuan carrying Xiangu; Si Ren fled to Yagai and led troops and elephants to invade Longchuan, wishing to abduct Xiangu away.
translations.idiomatic: Han Hong then fled to Longchuan with Xiangu; Si Ren withdrew to Yagai and raided Longchuan with soldiers and elephants to seize her.

sentences.zh: 會隴川有備，弗克，思仁亦走歸緬，緬偽署思仁於孟密，食其地。

translations.literal: Longchuan happened to be prepared; he could not succeed; Si Ren also fled back to Burma; Burma falsely installed Si Ren at Mengmi, consuming his lands.
translations.idiomatic: Longchuan was ready and repulsed him; Si Ren fled back to Burma, which installed him at Mengmi on paper while devouring the territory.

sentences.zh: 初，孟密寶井，朝廷每以中官出鎮，司采辦。

translations.literal: Initially, at Mengmi's precious mines, the court regularly sent eunuchs to garrison and oversee procurement.
translations.idiomatic: At Mengmi's gem mines the court habitually stationed eunuchs to supervise procurement.

sentences.zh: 武宗朝錢能最橫，至嘉靖、隆慶時猶然。

translations.literal: In Emperor Wuzong's reign Qian Neng was most overbearing; down to Jiajing and Longqing it remained so.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wuzong, Qian Neng had been the worst; the practice continued through Jiajing and Longqing.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十年，巡撫陳用賓言，緬酋擁眾直犯蠻莫，其執詞以奉開采使命令，殺蠻莫思正以開道路。

translations.literal: In Wanli year 20, Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin reported that the Burmese chieftain led a multitude straight to invade Mangmo, their pretext being obedience to mining procurement edicts—they killed Mangmo's Sizheng to open roads.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 20 Chen Yongbin reported that a Burmese chief invaded Mangmo on the pretext of mining orders, killing Mangmo's Sizheng to clear the route.

sentences.zh: 全滇之禍，皆自開采啟之。

translations.literal: The calamities of all Yunnan all began from mining procurement.
translations.idiomatic: Every disaster in Yunnan had begun with the mining missions.

sentences.zh: 時稅使楊榮縱其下，以開采為名，恣暴橫，蠻人苦之。

translations.literal: At the time the tax envoy Yang Rong indulged his subordinates; under the name of mining procurement they wilfully committed violence and tyranny; the tribes suffered bitterly.
translations.idiomatic: Tax commissioner Yang Rong's subordinates looted under cover of mining procurement, and the tribes suffered terribly.

sentences.zh: 且欲令麗江退地聽采，緬酋因得執詞深入。

translations.literal: Moreover he wished to make Lijiang withdraw lands for mining; the Burmese chieftain thereby obtained pretext to penetrate deeply.
translations.idiomatic: He also demanded that Lijiang cede land for mining, giving Burmese leaders a pretext to push deeper in.

sentences.zh: 巡按宋興祖極言其害，請追還榮等，帝皆不納。

translations.literal: Touring Censor Song Xingzu strongly stated the harms and requested recall of Rong and others; the emperor none of it accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Touring censor Song Xingzu protested urgently and asked that Rong be recalled; the emperor ignored him.

sentences.zh: 凡采辦必先輸官，然後與商賈貿易，每往五六百人。

translations.literal: Generally procurement required first delivering to the government, then trading with merchants; each expedition numbered five or six hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Procured goods had to go to the government first before merchant trade; each mission sent five or six hundred men.

sentences.zh: 其屬有地羊寨，在孟密東，往來道所必經。

translations.literal: Among its subordinates was Diyan Stockade, east of Mengmi, unavoidable on the travel routes.
translations.idiomatic: One dependency was Diyan Stockade, east of Mengmi, on every outbound route.

sentences.zh: 人工幻術，采辦人有強索其飲食者，多腹痛死；

translations.literal: Its people practiced illusion arts; procurement personnel who forcibly demanded their food and drink mostly died of belly pain;
translations.idiomatic: Its people knew conjuring tricks; procurement agents who forced them for food and drink often died of stomach agony;

sentences.zh: 己所乘馬亦斃，剖之，則馬腹皆木石也。

translations.literal: the horses they rode also died; when dissected, the horses' bellies were all wood and stone.
translations.idiomatic: their own mounts collapsed too, and when cut open the bellies were stuffed with wood and stone.

sentences.zh: 思真嘗剿之，殺數千人，不得絕。

translations.literal: Sizhen once suppressed them, killing several thousand, but could not exterminate them.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhen once campaigned against them, killing thousands, but could not root them out.

sentences.zh: 至是，復議剿，以兵少中止。

translations.literal: At this point they again deliberated suppression but halted for lack of troops.
translations.idiomatic: Suppression was debated again but dropped for lack of troops.

sentences.zh: 孟養，蠻名迤水，有香柏城。

translations.literal: Mengyang—the tribal name Yishui—has Xiangbai City.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyang, known to the tribes as Yishui, has the city of Xiangbai.

sentences.zh: 元至元中，於孟養置雲遠路軍民總管府。

translations.literal: In the middle of Zhiyuan in Yuan, the Yunyuan Circuit Military-Civilian General Pacification Office was established at Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the mid-Zhiyuan period the Yuan placed the Yunyuan circuit military-civilian headquarters at Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年改為雲遠府。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 15 it was changed to Yunyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 15 it became Yunyuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其地故屬平緬宣慰司。

translations.literal: Its territory formerly belonged to the Pingmian Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The territory had belonged to Pingmian pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 平緬思倫發為其下所逐，走京師。

translations.literal: Pingmian's Si Lunfa was driven out by his subordinates and fled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Si Lunfa of Pingmian was ousted by his followers and fled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝命西平侯沐春以兵納之，還故地。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Western Pacification Marquis Mu Chun to escort him with troops and restore his former territory.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Marquis Mu Chun to restore him by force.

sentences.zh: 成祖即位，改雲遠府為孟養府，以土官刀木旦為知府。

translations.literal: When Emperor Chengzu took the throne, Yunyuan Prefecture was changed to Mengyang Prefecture, with native official Dao Mudan as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzu renamed Yunyuan prefecture Mengyang and appointed the native official Dao Mudan prefect.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，刀木旦遣人貢方物及金銀器，賜賚遣歸。

translations.literal: In Yongle 1, Dao Mudan sent men offering local products and gold and silver vessels; grants were bestowed and they were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 Dao Mudan sent tribute of local goods and gold and silver ware and was rewarded and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 二年改升軍民宣慰使司，以刀木旦為使，賜誥印。

translations.literal: In year 2 it was promoted to a Military-Civilian Pacification Commission, with Dao Mudan as commissioner; patent and seal were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 it was promoted to a military-civilian pacification commission; Dao Mudan received patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 四年，孟養與戛裏相仇殺，緬甸宣慰那羅塔乘釁劫之，殺刀木旦及子思欒發而據其地。

translations.literal: In year 4, Mengyang and Gali were mutually feuding and killing; Burma Pacification Commissioner Narata seized the opportunity to raid, killing Dao Mudan and his son Siluanfa and occupying their territory.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 Mengyang and Gali were at war; Narata of Burma seized the chance to attack, killing Dao Mudan and his son Siluanfa and taking the land.

sentences.zh: 事聞，詔行人張洪等賫敕諭責緬。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict ordered itinerant official Zhang Hong and others to deliver imperial instructions rebuking Burma.
translations.idiomatic: On report, Zhang Hong and others were sent with edicts rebuking Burma.

sentences.zh: 那羅塔懼，仍歸其境土。

translations.literal: Narata feared this and returned their border lands.
translations.idiomatic: Narata, afraid, returned the territory.

sentences.zh: 會木邦宣慰使罕賓法以那羅塔侵據孟養，請自率兵討，遂破緬甸城寨二十余，獲其象、馬獻京師。

translations.literal: At this point Mobang Pacification Commissioner Han Binfa, because Narata had invaded and occupied Mengyang, requested to lead troops himself to punish them; he thereupon broke more than twenty Burmese stockades and forts, captured their elephants and horses, and presented them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Mobang commissioner Han Binfa, citing Narata's seizure of Mengyang, asked to campaign himself; he overran twenty-odd Burmese forts and sent captured elephants and horses to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十四年復設孟養宣慰司，命刀木旦次子刀得孟為使，以木旦侄玉賓為同知。

translations.literal: In year 14 the Mengyang Pacification Commission was re-established; Dao Mudan's second son Dao Demeng was ordered commissioner, and Mudan's nephew Yu Bin assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 Mengyang pacification commission was restored; Dao Demeng, Mudan's second son, became commissioner, and Yu Bin, Mudan's nephew, assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 自木旦被害，司遂廢，孟養之人從玉賓散居幹崖、金沙江諸處者三千余人。

translations.literal: Since Mudan was killed the commission was abolished; more than three thousand people of Mengyang who followed Yu Bin scattered to Ganyai, the Jinsha River region, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: After Mudan's murder the commission lapsed; three thousand Mengyang people who followed Yu Bin scattered to Ganyai and the Jinsha River region.

sentences.zh: 朝廷嘗命玉賓署宣慰使以撫之，故仍命為本司同知，令其率眾復業。

translations.literal: The court had once ordered Yu Bin to act as Pacification Commissioner to pacify them; therefore he was still ordered native assistant commissioner and instructed to lead the multitude back to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: The court had once let Yu Bin act as commissioner to settle them, so he kept the assistant commission and was told to lead his people home.

sentences.zh: 十五年，刀得孟遣使貢馬及方物。

translations.literal: In year 15, Dao Demeng sent envoys offering horses and local products.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 Dao Demeng sent horses and local tribute.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年，刀玉賓奏：「伯父刀木旦被殺，蒙朝廷遣官訪玉賓，授同知，又阻於緬難，寄居金齒者二十余年。

translations.literal: In Xuande year 5, Dao Yu Bin memorialized: "My uncle Dao Mudan was killed; thanks to the court dispatching officials who sought me out and appointed me assistant commissioner, yet blocked by Burmese troubles, I have sojourned at Jinchi more than twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 5 Dao Yu Bin memorialized: "My uncle Dao Mudan was murdered; the court found me and made me assistant commissioner, but Burmese troubles blocked my return, and I have lived at Jinchi for more than twenty years.

sentences.zh: 今孟養地又為麓川宣慰思任發所據，乞遣兵送歸本土。」

translations.literal: Now Mengyang territory is again occupied by Luchuan Pacification Commissioner Si Lunfa; I beg troops escort me home to native soil."
translations.idiomatic: Now Luchuan commissioner Si Lunfa holds Mengyang; I ask that troops escort me home."

sentences.zh: 帝命黔國公沐晟遣還之，然其地仍為任發所有。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Duke of Qian Mu Sheng to send him back; yet the territory still remained in Lunfa's possession.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Duke Mu Sheng to escort him back, but the land remained Si Lunfa's.

sentences.zh: 時為孟養宣慰者名刀孟賓，亦寄居雲南。

translations.literal: The one then serving as Mengyang Pacification Commissioner was named Dao Mengbin; he also sojourned in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The reigning Mengyang commissioner, Dao Mengbin, also lived as a refugee in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 及任發敗奔緬甸，子機發潛匿孟養，求撫。

translations.literal: When Lunfa was defeated and fled to Burma, his son Jifa hid secretly in Mengyang and sought pacification.
translations.idiomatic: When Si Lunfa fled in defeat to Burma, his son Jifa hid in Mengyang and asked to submit.

sentences.zh: 正統十三年敕孟養頭目伴送思機發來朝，許以升賞，機發疑畏竟不至。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong year 13 an edict ordered Mengyang headmen to escort Si Jifa to court; promotion and reward were promised; Jifa suspected and feared and ultimately did not come.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 13 the court ordered Mengyang headmen to escort Si Jifa to court with promise of honors; Jifa, fearful and suspicious, never came.

sentences.zh: 帝以孟養宣慰頭目刀變蠻等匿機發，敕數其罪，曰：「孟養乃朝廷開設，爾刀變蠻等敢違朝命，一可伐。
