translations.literal: Babai was afraid and sent men to the army headquarters to submit in guilt."
translations.idiomatic: Babai was terrified and sent envoys to the army headquarters to submit.

sentences.zh: 乃以所陳詞奏聞。

translations.literal: He then memorialized their statement to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: He reported their submission to the throne.

sentences.zh: 因遣使敕諭車裏、木邦等曰：「曩者八百不恭朝命，爾等請舉兵誅討。

translations.literal: Envoys were then sent with edicts instructing Cheli, Mobang, and others: "Formerly Babai was disrespectful of the court's command and you asked to raise troops to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts were sent to Cheli, Mobang, and others: "When Babai defied the court, you asked to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 嘉爾忠誠，已從所請。

translations.literal: Commending your loyalty, We have granted your request.
translations.idiomatic: Honoring your loyalty, I granted your request.

sentences.zh: 今得西平侯奏，言八百已伏罪納款。

translations.literal: Now receiving the Marquis of Xiping's memorial stating that Babai has submitted in guilt and offered allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Xiping now reports that Babai has submitted and offered allegiance.

sentences.zh: 夫有罪能悔，宜赦宥之。

translations.literal: When the guilty can repent, they should be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Those who repent should be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 敕至，其悉止兵勿進。」

translations.literal: When this edict arrives, all of you halt your armies and advance no further."
translations.idiomatic: When this edict arrives, halt all armies and advance no further.

sentences.zh: 遂敕晟班師。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered Sheng to withdraw his army.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng was then ordered to withdraw his army.

sentences.zh: 四年降敕誡諭刀招散，刀招散遣人貢方物謝罪。

translations.literal: In the fourth year an edict of admonition was sent to Dao Zhaosan; he sent envoys offering local products to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 an admonitory edict was sent to Dao Zhaosan, who sent tribute to apologize.

sentences.zh: 帝以不誠，卻之。

translations.literal: The emperor, judging the apology insincere, refused it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor found the apology insincere and refused it.

sentences.zh: 五年貢使復來謝罪，命禮部受之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year tribute envoys came again to apologize; the Ministry of Rites was ordered to accept them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 tribute envoys came again to apologize, and the Ministry of Rites was ordered to receive them.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年遣內官洪仔生賫敕諭刀招散。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongxi the inner court eunuch Hong Zaisheng was sent bearing an edict to instruct Dao Zhaosan.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongxi 1 the palace eunuch Hong Zaisheng was sent with an edict for Dao Zhaosan.

sentences.zh: 宣德七年遣人來貢，因奏波勒土酋常糾土雅之兵入境殺掠，乞發兵討之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xuande envoys came with tribute and memorialized that the Boluo chieftain often rallied Tuya troops to raid and kill within their borders, begging that troops be sent to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 7 they sent tribute and reported that the Boluo chieftain often led Tuya forces to raid their territory, asking for troops to punish them.

sentences.zh: 帝以八百大甸去雲南五千餘里，波勒、土雅皆未嘗歸化，勞中國為遠蠻役，非計，止降敕撫諭而已。

translations.literal: The emperor held that Babai Greater Dian was more than five thousand li from Yunnan, and Boluo and Tuya had never submitted; to weary China in service to distant barbarians was not wise—only an edict of pacification was issued.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that Babai Greater Dian lay more than five thousand li from Yunnan and that Boluo and Tuya had never submitted; to exhaust China on distant barbarians was unwise, and only a pacifying edict was sent.

sentences.zh: 正統五年，八百貢使奏：「遞年進貢方物，土民不識禮法，不通漢語。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhengtong Babai tribute envoys memorialized: "Year after year we present tribute, but our people do not know ritual and law and do not understand Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 5 Babai envoys reported: "Each year we bring tribute, but our people know neither Chinese ritual nor the language.

sentences.zh: 乞依永樂間例，仍令通事賫捧金牌、信符，催督進貢，驛路令軍卒護送，庶無疏失。」

translations.literal: We beg that according to the Yongle precedent, interpreters again be allowed to carry gold tablets and credentials of trust to urge tribute, and that relay routes be guarded by soldiers so that nothing is lost."
translations.idiomatic: We ask, as in the Yongle period, that interpreters carry gold tablets and credentials to urge tribute, and that soldiers escort the relay routes so nothing is lost.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，給八百大甸宣慰司金牌、信符各一，以前所給牌符為暹羅國寇兵焚毀也。

translations.literal: In the tenth year one gold tablet and one credential of trust were granted to the Babai Greater Dian Pacification Commission, because the former tablet and credential had been burned when Siam raided.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 Babai Greater Dian was granted a new gold tablet and credentials because Siam's raiders had burned the old ones.

sentences.zh: 成化十七年，安南黎灝已破老撾，頌偽敕於車裏，期會兵攻八百。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Chenghua Annam's Li Hao had already defeated Laos and proclaimed a forged edict in Cheli, fixing a date to attack Babai with combined forces.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 17 Annam's Li Hao had defeated Laos and proclaimed a forged edict in Cheli, scheduling a joint attack on Babai.

sentences.zh: 其兵暴死者數千，傳言為雷所震。

translations.literal: Several thousand of their troops died suddenly; rumor said they were struck by thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand of their troops died suddenly; rumor said thunder had struck them.

sentences.zh: 八百因遣兵扼其歸路，襲殺萬余，交人敗還。

translations.literal: Babai therefore sent troops to block their retreat route and ambushed and killed more than ten thousand; the Annamese were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Babai blocked their retreat and ambushed them, killing more than ten thousand; the Annamese were defeated and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 土官刀攬那以報。

translations.literal: Native official Dao Lanna reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Native official Dao Lanna reported the victory.

sentences.zh: 黔國公沐琮奏：「攬那能保障生民，擊敗交賊，救護老撾。

translations.literal: Duke of Qian Mu Cong memorialized: "Lanna has been able to protect the people, defeat the Annamese bandits, and rescue Laos.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Qian Mu Cong reported: "Lanna protected the people, defeated the Annamese, and rescued Laos.

sentences.zh: 交人嘗以偽敕脅誘八百，八百毀敕，以象蹴之，請頒賞以旌忠義。」

translations.literal: The Annamese once tried to coerce Babai with a forged edict; Babai destroyed the edict and trampled it with elephants. We ask that rewards be granted to honor this loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: The Annamese once tried to coerce Babai with a forged edict; Babai destroyed it and trampled it with elephants. We ask rewards to honor this loyalty.

sentences.zh: 帝命雲南布政司給銀百兩、彩幣四表裏以獎之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission to grant one hundred taels of silver and four suits of colored silks as reward.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Yunnan officials to grant one hundred taels of silver and four suits of colored silks as reward.

sentences.zh: 二十年，刀攬那遣人入貢。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Dao Lanna sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 Dao Lanna sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 雲南守臣言：「交兵雖退，宜令八百諸部飭兵為備。」

translations.literal: Yunnan frontier officials said: "Though the Annamese army has withdrawn, Babai's various domains should be ordered to ready troops as a precaution."
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan officials said: "Though the Annamese have withdrawn, Babai's domains should ready their troops.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年，刀攬那孫刀整賴貢方物，求襲祖職。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongzhi Dao Lanna's grandson Dao Zhenglai presented local products and sought to succeed his grandfather's office.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 2 Dao Lanna's grandson Dao Zhenglai sent tribute and sought to succeed his grandfather.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「八百遠離雲南，瘴毒之地，宜免勘予襲。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "Babai is far from Yunnan, a land of miasma; investigation should be waived and succession granted."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War said: "Babai lies far from Yunnan in malarial country; investigation should be waived and succession granted.

sentences.zh: 從之，仍給冠帶。

translations.literal: This was approved, and official robes and sash were granted.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved, and robes and sash were granted.

sentences.zh: 其地東至車裏，南至波勒，西至大古喇，與緬鄰，北至孟艮，自姚關東南行五十程始至。

translations.literal: Its territory extended east to Cheli, south to Boluo, west to Dagula bordering Burma, and north to Menggen; from Yaoguan one traveled southeast fifty stages to reach it.
translations.idiomatic: Its lands reached east to Cheli, south to Boluo, west to Dagula on the Burmese border, and north to Menggen—fifty stages southeast from Yaoguan.

sentences.zh: 平川數千里，有南格剌山，下有河，南屬八百，北屬車裏。

translations.literal: Level plains stretched thousands of li; Mount Nangela stood there with a river below—south of the river belonged to Babai, north to Cheli.
translations.idiomatic: Level plains stretched for thousands of li; below Mount Nangela a river divided Babai to the south from Cheli to the north.

sentences.zh: 好佛惡殺，寺塔以萬計。

translations.literal: They favored Buddhism and abhorred killing; temples and pagodas numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: They favored Buddhism and abhorred killing; temples and pagodas numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 有見侵，乃舉兵，得仇即已，俗名慈悲國。

translations.literal: When they saw invasion they would raise troops, but once revenge was obtained they stopped; popularly they were called the Compassionate Kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: When attacked they would fight, but once revenge was obtained they stopped; they were popularly called the Kingdom of Compassion.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖間，為緬所並，其酋避居景線，名小八百。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing period they were annexed by Burma; their chieftain fled to Jingxian, called Lesser Babai.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing period Burma annexed them; their chieftain fled to Jingxian in what was called Lesser Babai.

sentences.zh: 自是朝貢遂不至。

translations.literal: From then on tribute missions ceased to arrive.
translations.idiomatic: From then on tribute ceased.

sentences.zh: 緬酋應裏以弟應龍居景邁城，倚為右臂焉。

translations.literal: The Burma chieftain Yingli stationed his younger brother Yinglong at Jingmai city, relying on him as his right arm.
translations.idiomatic: Burma's Yingli stationed his brother Yinglong at Jingmai as his right hand.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十五年，八百大甸上書請恢復，不報。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Wanli Babai Greater Dian submitted a memorial requesting restoration; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 15 Babai Greater Dian petitioned for restoration; the court did not respond.

sentences.zh: 初，四譯館通事惟譯外國，而緬甸、八百如之，蓋二司於六慰中加重焉。

translations.literal: Initially the Four Translation Bureaus' interpreters translated only foreign states, and Burma and Babai were treated likewise—for these two commissions were given special weight among the six pacification domains.
translations.idiomatic: Originally the Four Translation Bureaus served only foreign states, and Burma and Babai were among them—these two commissions were given special weight among the six pacification domains.
